title: AIxDaily
overview_zh: 今日精选：AI × Chem 12 项，AI × Bio 14 项，AI × Math 14 项，AI Voices 10 项，Engineering 5 项。今日更新以预印本、公开帖文和开源项目为主：化学聚焦自改进分子发现、抗菌药物再利用与反应网络生成；生物覆盖医疗结局预测、肺部影像和儿科脑瘤诊断；数学推进分层奖励、证明评测与 Lean 验证。AI Voices 讨论上下文检索、3D 代码模型和药物开发基金；Engineering 聚焦设计审查、可审计 AI coworker 与 Agent Skills。前三项未见同行评议论文或新软件 Release。

channel_highlights.aixbio: 前三项均为 medRxiv/Europe PMC 预印本，覆盖大规模医疗结局、肺部影像和儿科脑瘤诊断；尚非同行评议，临床获益不能直接推出。
channel_highlights.aixmath: 前三项均为 arXiv 预印本，分别推进分层奖励、多格式证明评测与 Lean 代码验证；结果主要来自基准，非同行评议结论。
channel_highlights.aivoices: 前三项是 X 公开帖文：Mainplane 上下文检索、Qwen3.5-4B-3D-Coder 资料和 Formation Bio 基金公告，均属公开消息。
channel_highlights.engineering: 前三项是 GitHub Trending 项目，非新 Release，聚焦反 AI slop 设计与 AI coworker；热度为快照。

breaking_news.headline_zh: Lean 4 内核检验解决 Kullmann 的 w(2;3,21)=416 猜想，209 个情形由 cake_lpr 逐一排除
breaking_news.summary_zh: 研究者 Eitan Nahmias 宣布，Kullmann 的 w(2;3,21)=416 猜想已由 Lean 4 定理解决；209 个候选情形经内核检查均被 cake_lpr 排除，证明记录已公开。
breaking_news.why_breaking_zh: 它直接触及 Google DeepMind 形式猜想库中的开放问题，并把组合数学结论落到可复核的内核检查证明，展示 AI 辅助证明从候选解答走向机器验证。

breaking_news.headline_zh: ReactNexus 生成并验证完整反应网络：从反应物图搜索无预设产物的机理路径
breaking_news.summary_zh: 预印本提出 ReactNexus，从反应物图生成过渡态、完整反应轨迹和反应网络，再用机器学习原子间势及 DFT/IRC 验证；作者报告 1 万个候选中 80.8% 通过连接验证，并以碳正离子级联和质谱案例展示用途。
breaking_news.why_breaking_zh: 它把生成式模型从单步产物预测推进到可检验的反应网络与机理搜索，可能改变反应发现的探索空间；当前证据仍集中在有限体系，外推性需继续验证。

breaking_news.headline_zh: Mainplane 以完整会话检索替代有损压缩，开源代理恢复上下文的成本与等待显著下降
breaking_news.summary_zh: 研究者 Alexander Yue 发布 MIT 开源 Mainplane：保留完整代理会话，新会话按需检索原文；约 40 万 token 会话中，恢复耗时 38 秒、成本 1.99，降至 15 秒和 0.10。
breaking_news.why_breaking_zh: 它把代理记忆从手工摘要改成可检索的完整记录，直面长上下文的信息损失与缓存依赖，并以开源实现影响后续代理运行时设计。

items.title: MoLRSI: A Recursive Self-Improving AI agent for Molecular Discovery
items.abstract_or_text: Molecular discovery requires navigating vast combinatorial search spaces while balancing competing biological objectives. AI agents can automate expert-defined molecular design protocols, but automation alone does not address how to optimize workflows for new tasks or improve their development through experience. Here we introduce MoLRSI, an AI agent that combines systematic optimization of workflows and model architectures with persistent cross-task memory to recursively improve its search policy for molecular discovery. Workflow performance, refinement outcomes, and execution feedback guide subsequent searches, allowing the agent to improve both its workflows and its strategy for developing them. We evaluate MoLRSI in two challenging molecular discovery settings that require balancing competing properties. In antibiotic discovery, MoLRSI developed a screening workflow balancing antibacterial activity, cytotoxicity and structural novelty, achieving an experimental hit rate of 15.9%, compared with 8.7% for a previous expert-led workflow using the same training data and screening library. In de novo peptide-MHC binder design, MoLRSI developed workflows that jointly consider target binding and specificity, producing eight experimentally validated hits against MART-1 and SARS-CoV-1 pMHCs with preferential binding over tested off-targets while Claude Science completely failed. These findings demonstrate how experience-guided workflow optimization can address competing discovery objectives while improving the search strategies used in subsequent campaigns.
items.summary_zh: MoLRSI通过持久化跨任务记忆和递归优化，自动改进分子发现工作流与搜索策略；在抗生素筛选和肽-MHC结合剂设计中取得了实验验证的命中。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 将智能体从执行既定流程推进到优化流程本身，并在两个发现任务中给出实验命中证据。局限是实验规模仍有限，且比较依赖既有训练数据、筛选库和基线工作流。
items.abstract_zh: 分子发现需要在巨大的组合搜索空间中导航，同时平衡相互竞争的生物学目标。AI智能体可以自动执行专家定义的分子设计方案，但自动化本身并不能解决如何针对新任务优化工作流，或如何通过经验改进工作流开发的问题。我们提出MoLRSI，这是一种AI智能体，将工作流和模型架构的系统优化与持久化跨任务记忆结合起来，从而递归地改进其分子发现搜索策略。工作流性能、改进结果和执行反馈会指导后续搜索，使该智能体能够改进工作流以及开发工作流的策略。我们在两个具有挑战性的分子发现场景中评估MoLRSI，这些场景都要求平衡相互竞争的性质。在抗生素发现中，MoLRSI开发了一个平衡抗菌活性、细胞毒性和结构新颖性的筛选工作流，在使用相同训练数据和筛选库时，实验命中率达到15.9%，而此前专家主导工作流为8.7%。在从头设计肽-MHC结合剂的任务中，MoLRSI开发了同时考虑靶标结合和特异性的工作流，针对MART-1和SARS-CoV-1 pMHC产生了8个经过实验验证的命中物，并且相对于测试的脱靶物表现出优先结合，而Claude Science完全失败。这些结果表明，经验驱动的工作流优化能够处理相互竞争的发现目标，并改进后续发现活动中使用的搜索策略。

items.title: Interpreting Graph Neural Networks for Antibacterial Drug Repurposing against Acinetobacter baumannii
items.abstract_or_text: Antimicrobial resistance in Acinetobacter baumannii, whose carbapenem-resistant strains are classified by the World Health Organization as a critical priority, has motivated machine-learning screens for new antibacterials, but translating predictions into chemical hypotheses requires evaluating the molecular features on which a model relies. A graph neural network ensemble achieves competitive predictive performance against a descriptor-augmented reference model on the same antibacterial screen while using only atom features and connectivity, allowing interpretation to focus on the molecular graph without a separate input of handcrafted descriptors. The atom-level explanations identify features supporting the model's activity predictions under perturbation and restoration, while comparisons with equally sized perturbations within each molecule distinguish piperazine as the most consistently supported recurring contributor to predicted activity. Prospective screening of the Drug Repurposing Hub followed by developability and safety assessment yields a ranked shortlist for experimental follow-up and leads to testing of CE3F4, which reduced A. baumannii growth by 57% at 0.25 mM in a preliminary assay with a non-monotonic concentration--response profile.
items.summary_zh: 研究用图神经网络解释Acinetobacter baumannii抗菌活性预测，并据此筛选Drug Repurposing Hub，最终测试CE3F4。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 把分子图解释与前瞻性药物再利用筛选连接起来，并报告了初步抑菌实验。需要注意的是CE3F4的效应仅在0.25 mM、单一初步测定中观察到，且浓度-反应关系非单调。
items.abstract_zh: Acinetobacter baumannii的抗微生物耐药性，尤其是其碳青霉烯耐药菌株已被世界卫生组织列为最高优先级，这推动了利用机器学习筛选新型抗菌药物。然而，要将预测转化为化学假设，还需要评估模型所依赖的分子特征。一个图神经网络集成模型在相同抗菌筛选数据上，相对于加入描述符的参考模型取得了具有竞争力的预测性能，同时只使用原子特征和连接关系，因此可以将解释集中于分子图，而无需额外输入人工设计的描述符。原子层面的解释通过扰动和恢复识别支持模型活性预测的特征；在每个分子内与等规模扰动进行比较后，piperazine被确定为对预测活性支持最一致的重复出现贡献因素。对Drug Repurposing Hub进行前瞻性筛选，并开展成药性和安全性评估，得到一个供实验跟进的排序候选清单，随后测试CE3F4；在初步测定中，CE3F4在0.25 mM时使A. baumannii生长降低了57%，但浓度-反应关系呈非单调性。
items.author_line: Romano, S., Grassia, M., Righelli, D., Lio, P., Mangioni, G., Taccioli, C.

items.title: Generative discovery of chemical reaction networks
items.abstract_or_text: Chemical kinetics determines molecular stability, reaction selectivity and the evolution of reacting mixtures, but discovering the underlying reaction networks remains challenging. Here we introduce ReactNexus, a generative framework for kinetic-guided network exploration starting solely from reactant graphs. Generative models propose transition states and predict the full reaction trajectories connecting reactants and products, while calculations using a machine-learned interatomic potential verify connectivity and evaluate electronic barriers. On an in-distribution benchmark of 10,000 generated candidates, 80.8% connect to the input reactant after density functional theory (DFT) optimization and intrinsic reaction coordinate verification. The resulting networks uncover lower-barrier cooperative pathways and competition between catalyst release and catalyst-bound branches. In the examined carbocation cascades, coverage of known product precursors saturates after limited expansion and distinct entries converge onto shared intermediates, indicating a compact accessible reaction space. Network-derived candidate structures further assist mass-spectral interpretation of a complex nucleophilic aromatic substitution reaction. Together, these results establish a generative approach to reaction-network discovery and mechanistic analysis without predefined products or reaction templates.
items.summary_zh: ReactNexus从反应物图出发生成过渡态和完整反应轨迹，用机器学习原子间势与DFT/IRC验证反应网络，探索无预设产物或模板的反应机制。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 为反应网络和机理发现提供了生成式路线，并在10,000个候选中有80.8%通过连接验证。局限是主要证据来自特定碳正离子级联和一个质谱解释案例，外推到更广泛反应类型仍需验证。
items.abstract_zh: 化学动力学决定分子稳定性、反应选择性以及反应混合物的演化，但发现其背后的反应网络仍然具有挑战性。在这里，我们提出ReactNexus，这是一种仅从反应物图出发、由动力学引导的网络探索生成框架。生成模型提出过渡态并预测连接反应物和产物的完整反应轨迹；同时，利用机器学习原子间势进行计算，以验证连接关系并评估电子势垒。在包含10,000个生成候选的分布内基准测试中，80.8%的候选在DFT优化和内禀反应坐标验证后能够与输入反应物连接。所得网络揭示了较低势垒的协同路径，以及催化剂释放分支与催化剂结合分支之间的竞争。在所研究的碳正离子级联反应中，已知产物前体的覆盖率在有限扩展后趋于饱和，不同入口会汇聚到共享中间体，表明可达反应空间较为紧凑。网络衍生的候选结构还帮助解释了一个复杂亲核芳香取代反应的质谱。总体而言，这些结果建立了一种无需预先指定产物或反应模板的反应网络发现与机理分析生成方法。
items.author_line: Yunhong Han, Gaopeng Ren, Yan Liu, Ronghua Zhang, Huangjiang Huang, Ruiqi Zhang, Zhaoxi Yu, Chuncheng Liu, Zhao Li, Xiaohan Lin, Jiaxu Wang, Yuxuan Qin, Meijie Wang, Guoshun Mei, Doudou Wang, Taoyong Cui, Haojun Jia, Chenru Duan, Qiyuan Zhao

items.title: PolyDiscover: an integrated trust-aware platform for multi-objective polymer discovery and simulation validation
items.abstract_or_text: Data-driven polymer discovery remains fragmented across databases, models, screening, literature, and simulations. We present PolyDiscover, a platform unifying multi-source property lookup, graph-neural-network prediction, trust-aware multi-objective screening, literature extraction, generative candidate exploration, and automated handoff to molecular-dynamics validation. Building on published ADEPT-PolyGraphMT, it harmonizes experimental, molecular-dynamics, density-functional-theory, and group-contribution data spanning 28 properties across about 13,000 real and one million virtual polymers. Its engine combines feasibility filtering and exact Pareto ranking with a trust score integrating similarity to known polymers, physical consistency, predictive uncertainty, and synthesizability, followed by diversity-aware shortlisting. Two case studies on lightweight, thermally stable structural materials and thermally stable electrical insulators, using monomer HOMO-LUMO gap as an insulation proxy, reduced a million-polymer search space to 30 chemically diverse candidates per task. Higher-fidelity molecular-dynamics and density-functional-theory calculations, interpreted after correcting systematic density underestimation by the molecular-dynamics protocol, showed retention of targeted property combinations. Ablation showed that trust-aware ranking shifted about one fifth of each shortlist toward more synthesizable chemistry closer to known polymers. A constrained natural-language interface translated a free-text request into a validated specification matching expert screening exactly, while staged literature evidence corroborated high glass-transition temperatures in polyimide-dominated shortlists against published experiments. PolyDiscover offers a traceable route from design intent to simulation-validated candidates, easing exploration of polymer chemical space.
items.summary_zh: PolyDiscover整合多源聚合物数据、图神经网络预测、可信度感知的多目标筛选、文献抽取、生成式探索和分子动力学验证，将约100万候选缩减为每个任务30个多样化候选。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 提供从设计意图到模拟验证的可追溯聚合物发现流程，并用消融和高保真MD/DFT支持可信度排序的作用。局限是案例仍以模拟验证和文献佐证为主，尚未证明大规模合成可行性。
items.abstract_zh: 数据驱动的聚合物发现仍然分散在数据库、模型、筛选、文献和模拟等环节。我们提出PolyDiscover，这是一个统一多源性质查询、图神经网络预测、可信度感知的多目标筛选、文献抽取、候选生成式探索以及自动交接到分子动力学验证的平台。在已发表的ADEPT-PolyGraphMT基础上，该平台整合了实验、分子动力学、密度泛函理论和基团贡献数据，覆盖28种性质，包含约13,000种真实聚合物和100万种虚拟聚合物。其引擎结合可行性过滤和精确Pareto排序，并使用整合已知聚合物相似性、物理一致性、预测不确定性和可合成性的可信度分数，随后进行兼顾多样性的候选短名单筛选。两个案例分别针对轻质且热稳定的结构材料，以及热稳定的电绝缘体；后一个案例使用单体HOMO-LUMO能隙作为绝缘性代理指标，将100万聚合物的搜索空间缩减为每个任务30个化学多样的候选。更高保真的分子动力学和密度泛函理论计算表明，在校正分子动力学方案系统性低估密度的问题后，目标性质组合仍得以保持。消融实验显示，可信度感知排序使每个短名单中约五分之一的候选转向更接近已知聚合物、也更易合成的化学空间。受约束的自然语言界面将自由文本请求转换为经验证的规格，并与专家筛选完全一致；分阶段的文献证据还以已发表实验结果佐证了以聚酰亚胺为主的短名单具有较高玻璃化转变温度。PolyDiscover为从设计意图到模拟验证的聚合物化学空间探索提供了一条可追溯路径。
items.author_line: Sobin Alosious, Guoyue Xu, Yuhan Liu, Renzheng Zhang, Meng Jiang, Tengfei Luo

items.title: AtomSteer: Test-Time Constraint Steering for Atomistic Generative Models
items.abstract_or_text: Diffusion and flow matching models offer scalable approaches to generating crystalline materials, molecular conformers, and protein-ligand complexes. However, satisfying crystallographic symmetry, structural geometry, and accurate stereochemistry remains challenging. Satisfying these requirements calls for corrections that preserve the geometry already captured by the pretrained model. In this work, we propose AtomSteer, a test-time inference framework for steering pretrained atomistic generative models with structural constraints. During sampling, AtomSteer corrects intermediate structure predictions with bounded local projections, graph-rigid stereochemical transformations, and projections over periodic symmetries, accepting updates that improve constraint satisfaction while limiting changes to the rest of the structure. We demonstrate AtomSteer across three pretrained backbones, FlowMM, ET-Flow, and Boltz-2, spanning de novo crystal generation and crystal structure prediction, molecular conformer generation, and protein-ligand complex structure prediction. AtomSteer improves space-group distribution coverage in de novo crystal generation and improves target space-group recovery in crystal structure prediction. AtomSteer improves molecular validity and E/Z stereochemical accuracy while retaining conformer ensemble fidelity. For protein-ligand complexes, AtomSteer reduces ligand E/Z errors relative to experimental reference structures while achieving competitive docking success and PoseBusters validity. Our method provides a unified framework for adding chemical and crystallographic control to existing atomistic generative models without retraining or architectural changes.
items.summary_zh: AtomSteer在推理时通过局部投影、图刚性立体化学变换和周期对称投影，约束FlowMM、ET-Flow和Boltz-2生成晶体、构象及蛋白质-配体复合物。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 无需重新训练即可把晶体学和化学约束加入多个原子生成模型，并在空间群覆盖、E/Z立体化学和PoseBusters有效性上取得改进。限制是结果仍依赖预训练骨干和测试基准，未显示实际合成或生物实验验证。
items.abstract_zh: 扩散模型和流匹配模型为生成晶体材料、分子构象和蛋白质-配体复合物提供了可扩展方法。然而，满足晶体学对称性、结构几何和准确立体化学仍然具有挑战性。满足这些要求需要进行能够保留预训练模型已捕获几何信息的校正。在这项工作中，我们提出AtomSteer，这是一种在推理时利用结构约束引导预训练原子生成模型的框架。在采样过程中，AtomSteer使用有界局部投影、图刚性立体化学变换以及周期对称投影来校正中间结构预测；它接受能够改善约束满足度、同时限制对结构其余部分改变的更新。我们在三个预训练骨干模型FlowMM、ET-Flow和Boltz-2上展示了AtomSteer，覆盖从头晶体生成、晶体结构预测、分子构象生成以及蛋白质-配体复合物结构预测。AtomSteer提高了从头晶体生成中的空间群分布覆盖率，也提高了晶体结构预测中的目标空间群恢复率。它提高了分子有效性和E/Z立体化学准确性，同时保持构象集合保真度。对于蛋白质-配体复合物，相比实验参考结构，AtomSteer减少了配体E/Z错误，并取得具有竞争力的对接成功率和PoseBusters有效性。该方法为在不重新训练或改变架构的情况下，向现有原子生成模型加入化学和晶体学控制提供了统一框架。
items.author_line: Pengfei Cai, Katharina S. C. Jäger, Utkarsh Utkarsh, Nofit Segal, Bowen Deng, Akshay Subramanian, Rafael Gomez-Bombarelli

items.title: From MS/MS evidence to adaptive spectroscopic characterization: Reinforcement learning guided by candidate molecular structures
items.abstract_or_text: Small-molecule identification from tandem mass spectrometry (MS/MS) may require complementary measurements. Herein, we propose a structure-informed deep Q-network (SI-DQN) that uses existing MS/MS evidence to decide whether further characterization is needed, which measurement to request, and when to stop. The policy combines spectral representations and candidate rankings with score-weighted descriptors of the candidates' chemical features and structural differences. The policy was evaluated on 79,462 held-out samples with simulated MS/MS, infrared (IR), and nuclear magnetic resonance (NMR) spectra from the Multimodal Spectroscopic Dataset. Evaluation used fixed hard candidate sets containing the correct structure and equal normalized acquisition costs. Averaged across three training runs, SI-DQN increased Top-1 accuracy from 80.10% to 93.78% for positive-ion MS/MS starts and from 70.44% to 93.31% for negative-ion starts. The corresponding mean additional measurement counts were only 0.227 and 0.340 per sample, respectively. Complete acquisition achieved 97.72% accuracy with four additions, whereas SI-DQN reduced the additional measurement count by 94.3% and 91.5%. Relative to a rule-based policy, SI-DQN reduced the composite loss combining terminal ranking error and acquisition cost by 19.3% and 25.5%. Adding structural information to DQN further improved accuracy while reducing requests across all three training runs. At comparable ranking uncertainty, SI-DQN increased request rates relative to DQN more strongly in groups with high structural disagreement, where larger reductions in composite loss were also observed. Together, these results support using the ambiguity among candidate structures after MS/MS analysis to guide further characterization, providing a quantitative basis for balancing identification performance against subsequent measurement effort.
items.summary_zh: SI-DQN根据MS/MS候选结构的不确定性，决定是否追加IR或NMR测量以及何时停止，在79,462个留出样本上提升鉴定准确率并减少测量次数。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 把候选结构差异纳入主动光谱采集决策，在模拟多模态数据上同时改善Top-1准确率和采集成本。主要限制是光谱为模拟数据、候选集固定且包含正确结构，现实样品中的候选生成和仪器成本尚未覆盖。
items.abstract_zh: 通过串联质谱（MS/MS）进行小分子鉴定可能需要互补测量。在这里，我们提出结构信息增强的深度Q网络（SI-DQN），利用已有MS/MS证据决定是否需要进一步表征、请求哪种测量以及何时停止。该策略结合光谱表征和候选排序，并加入候选化学特征及结构差异的按分数加权描述符。在多模态光谱数据集的模拟MS/MS、红外（IR）和核磁共振（NMR）光谱上，使用79,462个留出样本评估该策略。评估采用固定的严格候选集，其中包含正确结构，并使用相同的归一化采集成本。三次训练运行的平均结果显示，对于从正离子MS/MS开始的样本，SI-DQN将Top-1准确率从80.10%提高到93.78%；对于负离子起始样本，则从70.44%提高到93.31%。相应的平均额外测量次数仅为每个样本0.227次和0.340次。完整采集在增加4次测量后达到97.72%的准确率，而SI-DQN将额外测量次数分别减少了94.3%和91.5%。相对于基于规则的策略，SI-DQN将结合终端排序误差和采集成本的复合损失分别降低了19.3%和25.5%。在DQN中加入结构信息后，在三次训练运行中均进一步提高了准确率并减少了请求次数。在排序不确定性相当的情况下，SI-DQN在结构分歧较高的分组中相对于DQN更强地提高了请求率；这些分组中的复合损失降幅也更大。总体而言，这些结果支持利用MS/MS分析后候选结构之间的歧义来指导进一步表征，为在鉴定性能与后续测量工作量之间取得平衡提供了定量依据。
items.author_line: Bowen Gao, Lei Zhu, Yiying Wang, Wenjie Yu

items.title: Hierarchical Copper-Based Metal-Organic Frameworks for Improved Catalytic Performance
items.abstract_or_text: Introducing additional meso- or macroporosity into traditionally microporous metal-organic frameworks (MOFs) can greatly improve the catalytic performance of these materials, by reducing diffusional barriers during reactions. In this study, we demonstrate that HKUST-1 synthesized via supercritical CO2-assisted crystallization (referred to here as “scCO2-HKUST”) forms a hierarchically porous structure, combining intrinsic microporosity with newly formed macropores. X-ray diffraction (PXRD), scanning electron microscopy (SEM), and gas sorption analyses confirmed the preservation of the crystal structure alongside macropore formation. X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy (XPS) revealed a higher proportion of low-valent copper species (Cuo/Cu+) in scCO₂-HKUST compared to conventional HKUST-1, indicative of increased coordinatively unsaturated metal sites. In catalytic CO oxidation, scCO2-HKUST achieved higher conversion rates than normal HKUST-1 between 220 and 260 oC, with complete CO conversion at 260 °C versus 280 °C for the conventional sample. This enhanced activity is attributed to faster molecular diffusion through the macropores and greater accessibility of reactive copper sites.
items.summary_zh: 通过超临界CO2辅助结晶制备具有宏孔的层级多孔HKUST-1；表征显示晶体结构保持且低价铜比例增加，CO氧化完全转化温度由280 °C降至260 °C。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 将传质改善和铜活性位点可及性提升联系到可测的催化性能增益，并有PXRD、SEM、气体吸附和XPS等多种表征支持。局限是研究集中于单一MOF和CO氧化模型反应，长期稳定性与普适性尚待验证。
items.abstract_zh: 在传统微孔金属-有机框架（MOF）中引入额外的介孔或宏孔，可以通过降低反应过程中的扩散障碍显著改善这些材料的催化性能。在本研究中，我们证明，通过超临界CO2辅助结晶合成的HKUST-1（此处称为“scCO2-HKUST”）形成了层级多孔结构，将本征微孔性与新形成的宏孔结合起来。X射线衍射（PXRD）、扫描电子显微镜（SEM）和气体吸附分析证实，在形成宏孔的同时晶体结构得以保持。X射线光电子能谱（XPS）显示，与常规HKUST-1相比，scCO2-HKUST中低价铜物种（Cuo/Cu+）的比例更高，表明配位不饱和金属位点增加。在催化CO氧化中，scCO2-HKUST在220至260 °C之间的转化率高于普通HKUST-1；完全CO转化温度为260 °C，而常规样品为280 °C。这种活性增强归因于分子通过宏孔的扩散更快，以及反应性铜位点的可及性更高。
items.author_line: Huan Doan, Ken Chiang, Srinivasan Madapusi, Samuel Pattisson, David J. Morgan, Stuart H. Taylor, Valeska Ting

items.title: Framework-Conditional Open Materials Generation
items.abstract_or_text: Theoretical predictions of novel materials rely on a variety of techniques, from data-mining-based ion substitution methods to fully de novo generative models. Each approach imposes specific constraints and encounters unique challenges when extrapolating beyond the distribution of known materials to discover new ones. The foremost goal of materials generation is to produce stable, unique, and novel (S.U.N.) structures. Predicted structures that meet these criteria, however, typically result from novel chemical compositions mapped onto known structural prototypes or frameworks. We leverage this heuristic insight to present a new generative paradigm for the de novo prediction of inorganic crystalline materials constrained by their structural framework---i.e., the unit cell shapes and respective particle positions. Our method, termed OMatG-FC (Open Materials Framework-Conditional Generation), learns via a combination of discrete flow matching on the atomic species and stochastic interpolants for the volume scaling of the unit cell lattice, while fixing in-place the fractional coordinates and the unit-volume lattice vectors, dramatically reducing the dimensionality of the problem compared to unconstrained (framework-free) generation. Our method is more flexible than existing prototype-constrained methods, demonstrating capability for discovery of unseen, stable prototypes derived from known structural frameworks. We also investigate the number of unique frameworks in the MP-20 dataset, demonstrating the propensity of duplicate frameworks within the dataset and providing a framework-split version. We benchmark the performance of our model using the LeMat-GenBench suite using three ML interatomic potentials and achieve state-of-the-art S.U.N. rate below the convex hull, eschewing the need to learn atomic packings for materials discovery.
items.summary_zh: OMatG-FC固定结构框架的分数坐标和单位体积晶格向量，仅生成原子种类与晶胞体积，从而降低无机晶体生成难度，并在LeMat-GenBench上取得较高S.U.N.率。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 利用结构框架条件化缓解从头材料生成的维度和稳定性难题，并显式处理MP-20中的框架重复。限制是稳定性主要由ML原子间势评估，仍需实验合成确认。
items.abstract_zh: 新材料的理论预测依赖多种技术，从基于数据挖掘的离子替换方法到完全从头的生成模型。每种方法都施加了特定约束，并在超出已知材料分布进行发现时面临独特挑战。材料生成的首要目标是得到稳定、独特且新颖（S.U.N.）的结构。然而，满足这些标准的预测结构通常是将新化学组成映射到已知结构原型或框架上。我们利用这一启发式认识，提出一种新的生成范式：在结构框架约束下从头预测无机晶体材料，即固定晶胞形状及其中粒子的位置。该方法称为OMatG-FC（Open Materials Framework-Conditional Generation），通过结合原子种类上的离散流匹配与晶胞晶格体积缩放上的随机插值进行学习，同时固定分数坐标和单位体积晶格向量，从而相比无约束的无框架生成大幅降低问题维度。我们的方法比现有原型约束方法更加灵活，能够从已知结构框架衍生出的未见稳定原型中发现材料。我们还研究了MP-20数据集中独特框架的数量，显示该数据集存在重复框架倾向，并提供了按框架划分的版本。我们使用LeMat-GenBench套件和三个机器学习原子间势对模型进行基准测试，在凸包以下实现了最先进的S.U.N.率，而无需学习原子堆积。
items.author_line: Maya M. Martirossyan, Hillary Pan, Philipp Höllmer, Stefano Martiniani

items.title: TACFormer: Transformer-Based Generative Model for Target-Conditioned De Novo PROTAC Design
items.abstract_or_text: Targeted protein degradation (TPD) represents a fundamental shift in drug discovery, moving beyond traditional target inhibition toward the event-driven removal of disease-causing proteins. A prominent strategy for TPD is the use of proteolysis-targeting chimeras (PROTACs), heterobifunctional molecules that selectively route a protein of interest (POI) to the ubiquitin-proteasome system for degradation. While PROTAC design still relies heavily on trial-and-error synthesis and experimental testing, deep generative models offer a promising means to explore PROTAC chemical space in silico and generate novel molecules. However, many existing generative methods formulate PROTAC design primarily as a linker-generation problem, with POI-binding (warhead) and E3-ligase-binding components fixed in advance. This restricts exploration of the full PROTAC chemical space and often leaves the POI implicit through the predefined warhead, rather than using protein-level information as an explicit conditioning signal during generation. To address these limitations, we propose TACFormer: a transformer-based generative model for target-aware de novo PROTAC design. The model conditions a GPT-style molecular decoder on pretrained ESM-2 representations of POI sequences, allowing POI-level information to steer full-molecule generation. Our results show that TACFormer generates highly novel and chemically diverse PROTACs while showing consistent POI-dependent shifts in generated chemical space. In particular, molecules generated under specific target conditions preferentially populate chemical neighborhoods associated with POIs in the held-out dataset, while extrapolating to novel chemotypes. By natively integrating biological context into the generative process, TACFormer moves PROTAC design toward a more biology-informed exploration of degrader chemical space.
items.summary_zh: TACFormer以POI序列的ESM-2表示作为条件，通过GPT式分子解码器生成完整PROTAC，而不再固定warhead和E3连接部分。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 把蛋白质层面的靶标信息直接引入PROTAC全分子生成，拓展了从连接子优化到全化学空间探索的范围。证据主要是数据集上的新颖性、多样性和靶标条件偏移，尚未有合成或降解活性验证。
items.abstract_zh: 靶向蛋白质降解（TPD）代表了药物发现中的根本转变：从传统的靶点抑制转向事件驱动地清除致病蛋白。TPD的一种主要策略是蛋白酶靶向嵌合体（PROTAC），这类双功能分子能够选择性地将目标蛋白（POI）引导至泛素-蛋白酶体系统进行降解。尽管PROTAC设计仍高度依赖试错式合成和实验测试，深度生成模型为在计算机内探索PROTAC化学空间并生成新分子提供了有前景的手段。然而，许多现有生成方法主要把PROTAC设计表述为连接子生成问题，并预先固定POI结合部分（warhead）和E3连接酶结合部分。这限制了对完整PROTAC化学空间的探索，而且通常通过预定义warhead使POI保持隐式状态，而不是在生成过程中使用蛋白质层面的信息作为显式条件信号。为解决这些局限，我们提出TACFormer，这是一种面向靶标的从头PROTAC设计Transformer生成模型。该模型以POI序列的预训练ESM-2表示为条件，驱动GPT式分子解码器，从而允许POI层面的信息引导完整分子生成。结果显示，TACFormer生成的PROTAC具有很高的新颖性和化学多样性，并且生成化学空间会随POI发生一致性偏移。具体而言，在特定靶标条件下生成的分子，优先进入与留出数据集中POI相关的化学邻域，同时还能外推到新的化学类型。通过将生物学背景原生地整合进生成过程，TACFormer推动PROTAC设计朝向更具生物学信息的降解剂化学空间探索发展。
items.author_line: Yossra Gharbi, Rocío Mercado

items.title: El Agente Quntur: Agentic Active-Space Selection for CASSCF
items.abstract_or_text: Multireference calculations often require substantial human expertise and time to choose and refine an active space for the electronic states or chemical process of interest. This involves selecting which orbitals to include, verifying that the calculation describes the intended excited state, and deciding whether the results have converged. Here, we ask whether scientific agentic systems (harnesses) can make these decisions reliably. We use the El Agente Quntur multi-agent harness, with GPT-5.6 Sol and GPT-5.6 Terra as the underlying LLM components, to explore 32 diverse singlet excitations at fixed molecular geometries. The agents planned and executed calculations, choosing and refining active spaces under prompts that specified equal-weight two-singlet state-averaged CASSCF followed by strongly contracted NEVPT2 with def2-TZVPD. We evaluate excitation energies against published CASPT2 reference values at matching geometries and compare performance with six deterministic Active Space Finder protocols. Within the El Agente Quntur system, agents detect missing active orbitals, compare candidate excited states, and revise state assignments as calculations progress. Agentic execution reduced mean absolute error by 48\% relative to the state-of-the-art Active Space Finder protocol. We note that computational traces vary substantially across runs in both active space selection strategies and cost, even for the same molecule. Our results underscore the advantage of agentic active space selection over fixed workflows, yet leave room to improve efficiency through runtime-aware decision-making, reduced inter-agent communication overhead and redundancy, more systematic checks of state identity, and clearer stopping criteria.
items.summary_zh: El Agente Quntur用多智能体系统自动选择和修正CASSCF活性空间，并在32个单重激发上与CASPT2及六种Active Space Finder流程比较。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 显示智能体可参与多参考量子化学计算中最依赖专家经验的活性空间决策，平均绝对误差较最佳确定性协议降低48%。但不同运行的轨迹和成本波动较大，停止标准和可复现性仍是关键问题。
items.abstract_zh: 多参考计算通常需要大量人类专业知识和时间来选择并优化针对目标电子态或化学过程的活性空间。这包括选择要纳入的轨道、验证计算是否描述了目标激发态，以及判断结果是否收敛。在这里，我们探讨科学智能体系统（harness）能否可靠地完成这些决策。我们使用El Agente Quntur多智能体harness，以GPT-5.6 Sol和GPT-5.6 Terra作为底层LLM组件，在固定分子几何结构下研究32个不同的单重激发。智能体按照指定等权双重态平均CASSCF、随后使用def2-TZVPD进行强收缩NEVPT2的提示，规划并执行计算，选择和优化活性空间。我们将激发能与相同几何结构下已发表的CASPT2参考值进行比较，并与六种确定性Active Space Finder协议比较性能。在El Agente Quntur系统中，智能体能够检测缺失的活性轨道、比较候选激发态，并随着计算推进修正态分配。相对于最先进的Active Space Finder协议，智能体执行使平均绝对误差降低了48%。我们注意到，即使对于同一分子，不同运行在活性空间选择策略和成本方面也会出现显著差异。这些结果凸显了智能体活性空间选择相对于固定工作流的优势，但也表明仍需通过考虑运行时间的决策、减少智能体间通信开销和冗余、更系统地检查态身份以及制定更清晰的停止标准来提高效率。
items.author_line: Juan B. Pérez-Sánchez, Viviana Roman-Ventura, Olalla Nieto-Faza, Aiwei Yin, Alán Aspuru-Guzik, Varinia Bernales

items.title: Development of a Deep Reinforcement Learning Approach for Transition State Search in Molecular Systems: A Transferable Model Across Structural and Dimensional Variations
items.abstract_or_text: We developed a DRL approach for TS searches combining the deep Q-network and the bidirectional long short-term memory architectures to handle variable-sized molecular systems. We applied our method to 1,3,5-hexatriene (Triene), alanine dipeptide (Ala2), and 1,3,5,7-octatetraene (Tetraene) as target systems with the search space limited to backbone dihedral angles. Our model successfully learned the TS search tasks for all examined systems. More importantly, we demonstrate that our model pre-trained on Triene exhibits distinct transfer-learning capabilities across both backbone modifications (Triene to Ala2) and chain extensions (Triene to Tetraene). Such transferability is highly promising for future applications to molecules in general, as it allows an agent trained on simple systems to accelerate TS searches in larger or more complex ones. We expect that these findings on cross-system transferability represent an important step forward in developing DRL-based approaches for TS searches.
items.summary_zh: 该方法将深度Q网络与双向长短期记忆网络结合，用于可变大小分子体系的过渡态搜索，并展示从1,3,5-hexatriene向Ala2和1,3,5,7-octatetraene的迁移。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 直接针对过渡态搜索中的可变体系规模和迁移能力，说明在简单分子上预训练可能加速更复杂体系的搜索。当前验证仅覆盖三个模型体系，搜索空间也限制在主链二面角。
items.abstract_zh: 我们开发了一种结合深度Q网络和双向长短期记忆架构的过渡态搜索深度强化学习方法，用于处理可变大小的分子体系。我们将该方法应用于1,3,5-hexatriene（Triene）、alanine dipeptide（Ala2）和1,3,5,7-octatetraene（Tetraene）三个目标体系，并将搜索空间限制在主链二面角。我们的模型成功学习了所有所研究体系的过渡态搜索任务。更重要的是，我们展示了在Triene上预训练的模型同时具备跨主链修饰（Triene到Ala2）和链延伸（Triene到Tetraene）的迁移学习能力。这种可迁移性对未来将深度强化学习应用于一般分子很有前景，因为在简单体系上训练的智能体可以加速更大或更复杂体系的过渡态搜索。我们预计，这些关于跨体系迁移能力的结果代表了开发基于深度强化学习的过渡态搜索方法的重要一步。
items.author_line: Takechika Kikkawa, Shusuke Yamanaka, Takashi Kawakami, Mitsutaka Okumura

items.title: Folding and Function as Two Sides of One Coin: Statistical Mechanics, Information Theory, and Deep Learning of Binding, Catalysis, and Allostery in an Exactly Enumerable Lattice Protein
items.abstract_or_text: Folding and function depend on the same conformational ensemble, but they need not favor the same population distribution. We examine this relationship in a 27-residue lattice protein with 103,346 exactly enumerated compact conformations, combining statistical mechanics, information-theoretic analysis, and variational autoencoders. Exact identities separate binding into native-site recognition and population terms, distinguish transition-state complementarity from reorganization in catalysis, and express allosteric coupling as a conformational covariance. Under composition-conserving selection, binding and turnover optimization favor a dominant compact fold, whereas strong allostery can coexist with a distributed ensemble: pure coupling optimization gives a median native population of 0.47, compared with 0.85 when designs with additional stability rewards are pooled. Composition-free binding and catalytic selection provide further counterexamples to an unconditional function-to-folding implication. Rényi divergences quantify the shortfall from the best available binding or transition-state-recognition conformation; allosteric coupling instead depends on the magnitude and alignment of two ligand-induced responses. A sequence VAE generates target-fold-compatible sequences more frequently than an independent-site baseline and partially retains binding and catalytic properties, but not allosteric coupling. Time-lagged VAEs resolve additional basin information in selected allosteric trajectories, although incomplete interconversion prevents inference of equilibrium switching kinetics. Together, these results identify a conditional relationship between functional selection and fold specificity, and distinguish population concentration for recognition from population redistribution for allosteric communication.
items.summary_zh: 研究在可精确枚举的27残基格点蛋白模型中，结合统计力学、信息论和变分自编码器分析折叠、结合、催化与变构之间的条件关系。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 用精确枚举把构象群体、结合识别、催化重组和变构耦合分开量化，并检验VAE能否保留这些性质。局限是格点蛋白和不完全构象互变不能直接代表真实蛋白动力学。
items.abstract_zh: 折叠与功能依赖同一个构象集合，但二者未必偏好相同的群体分布。我们在一个含有27个残基、具有103,346个精确枚举紧致构象的格点蛋白中研究这种关系，并结合统计力学、信息论分析和变分自编码器。精确恒等式将结合分解为天然位点识别项和群体项，区分催化中的过渡态互补与重组，并将变构耦合表示为构象协方差。在保持组成不变的选择下，结合和周转优化偏好一个占主导地位的紧致折叠，而强变构可以与分散的构象集合共存：纯耦合优化得到的天然构象群体中位数为0.47，而合并额外稳定性奖励后设计得到的中位数为0.85。无组成约束的结合和催化选择进一步反驳了功能选择必然导致折叠特异性的说法。Rényi散度量化了相对于最佳可用结合或过渡态识别构象的不足；变构耦合则取决于两个配体诱导响应的幅度和一致性。序列VAE比独立位点基线更频繁地产生与目标折叠相容的序列，并部分保留结合和催化性质，但不能保留全部变构耦合。时间滞后VAE在选定的变构轨迹中解析出额外的能谷信息，然而构象之间的不完全互变阻止了对平衡切换动力学的推断。总体而言，这些结果确定了功能选择与折叠特异性之间的条件关系，并区分了识别所需的群体集中与变构通信所需的群体重分布。
items.author_line: Shubin Liu

items.title: Performance of a foundation model to generate thousands of predicted outcomes across multiple use cases
items.abstract_or_text: Background. Predictive artificial intelligence (AI) models hold great promise for medical care. While many types of models have proliferated across healthcare and the life sciences, systematic, rapid generation of multi-condition predictions of diagnoses, future medical events and future clinical outcomes from a single foundation-model architecture remains rare. PhenOM(R) is a generative AI foundation model trained and validated on longitudinal medical-event data from more than 400 million patient records in the OM1 Real World Data Cloud (RWDC) and designed to complete predictive tasks for a broad array of medical diagnoses, events and clinical outcomes (collectively outcomes) at varying time intervals, currently up to five (5) years. This paper describes the implementation of PhenOM to complete a vast number of predictive tasks across clinical domains and outcomes. Methods. PhenOM was evaluated across four outcome categories (Future Risk, Screening, Care Opportunity, and Treatment Effect) in multiple domains spanning chronic disease, acute medical events, healthcare utilization, and rare and frequently undiagnosed conditions. Performance was assessed using area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUROC). Outcomes were defined within an eligible-population framework using standardized medical code sets (ICD-10, SNOMED, CPT, NDC, LOINC) unless outcomes could not be specified with an existing code. All benchmarks reported were derived from data excluded from training. Results. As of this publication, the single PhenOM model has been used to complete and validate thousands of predictive tasks covering more than 1,770 outcomes spanning most organ systems and clinical specialties, with new predictive tasks being validated each day. Overall, 80 percent of predictive tasks achieved AUROC of at least 0.70 and 30 percent achieved AUROC of at least 0.80. We present a sample of 177 of these tasks as examples that show the breadth of tasks the model can complete. Performance varied systematically by outcome and clinical domain. Conclusions. PhenOM demonstrates the ability to complete thousands of predictive tasks across clinical domains and outcomes at the individual patient level, without additional training. Outcomes include screening for undiagnosed conditions, predicting future conditions, medical events, effects of treatments, and assessing care opportunities. These can be ascertained at the individual patient and population levels. These findings support applications in individual and population health management, risk management, drug development, and real-world evidence generation, and establish a transparent, reproducible performance reference for a large-scale real-world predictive AI platform.
items.summary_zh: PhenOM 在超过 4 亿份纵向患者记录上训练，覆盖 1770 多个结局和数千项预测任务，系统评估未来风险、筛查、照护机会和治疗效果。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 数据规模、任务覆盖和训练外基准使其成为大型真实世界医疗预测模型的可复现性能参考；但这是 preprint，AUROC 不能直接等同于临床获益或因果治疗效果。
items.abstract_zh: 背景：预测性人工智能（AI）模型有望用于医疗照护。尽管医疗和生命科学领域已经出现大量不同类型的模型，但由单一基础模型架构系统、快速地生成多疾病诊断、未来医疗事件和未来临床结局预测的工作仍然少见。PhenOM(R) 是一种生成式 AI 基础模型，在 OM1 Real World Data Cloud（RWDC）中超过 4 亿份患者记录组成的纵向医疗事件数据上训练和验证，旨在针对广泛的医疗诊断、未来事件和临床结局（统称为结局）完成预测任务，预测时间间隔目前最长可达五（5）年。本文介绍了 PhenOM 在多个临床领域和结局上完成大量预测任务的实现。方法：PhenOM 在四类结局（未来风险、筛查、照护机会和治疗效果）上进行评估，涵盖慢性病、急性医疗事件、医疗服务利用以及罕见和经常未被诊断的疾病。采用受试者工作特征曲线下面积（AUROC）评估性能。除非结局无法用现有代码指定，否则在符合条件的人群框架内使用标准化医疗编码集（ICD-10、SNOMED、CPT、NDC、LOINC）定义结局。所有报告的基准结果均来自训练时排除的数据。结果：截至本文发表时，单一 PhenOM 模型已经完成并验证了数千项预测任务，覆盖大多数器官系统和临床专科中的超过 1,770 个结局；新的预测任务仍在每天验证。总体而言，80% 的预测任务达到至少 0.70 的 AUROC，30% 达到至少 0.80。本文以 177 项任务为例，展示模型能够完成的任务广度。模型性能随结局和临床领域系统性变化。结论：PhenOM 无需额外训练即可在不同临床领域和结局上完成数千项预测任务，并在个体患者层面工作。结局包括筛查未诊断疾病、预测未来疾病和医疗事件、预测治疗效果以及评估照护机会；这些结局可在个体和人群层面判定。这些结果支持其用于个体和人群健康管理、风险管理、药物开发和真实世界证据生成，并为大规模真实世界预测 AI 平台建立了透明且可复现的性能参考。

items.title: PulmoDiagAI: An Intelligent Medical Diagnosis System for Automated Pulmonary Pathology Classification using Deep Learning
items.abstract_or_text: Abstract Lung cancer and Coronavirus Disease 2019 (COVID’19) remain among the leading causes of respiratory-related morbidity and mortality worldwide, highlighting the critical need for rapid, accurate, and automated diagnostic solutions. This study presents PulmoDiagAI, an intelligent computer-aided diagnosis (CAD) system that integrates state of the art deep learning techniques for the automated detection and classification of pulmonary diseases from chest X-ray and computed tomography (CT) images. Five pre-trained convolutional neural network (CNN) architectures, namely VGG19, ResNet50, MobileNetV3, EfficientNet-B3, and DenseNet121 were fine-tuned using a transfer learning strategy to identify the most effective model for each diagnostic task. A comprehensive preprocessing pipeline, including image standardization, median filtering, resizing, intensity normalization, and Contrast Limited Adaptive Histogram Equalization (CLAHE), was employed to enhance image quality and improve feature extraction. The proposed framework was evaluated on two publicly available benchmark datasets: IQ-OTH/NCCD for lung cancer detection and COVID-QU-Ex for COVID’19 diagnosis. Experimental results demonstrate that EfficientNet-B3 achieved superior performance for COVID’19 classifications, reaching an accuracy of 97.0% and an AUC-ROC of 99.43%. For lung cancer detection, MobileNetV3 and ResNet50 delivered outstanding results, achieving accuracies of 99.0% and 98.0%, respectively, with a perfect AUC-ROC of 100%. To facilitate clinical adoption, the proposed model was deployed as an intuitive graphical user interface (GUI) that provides real time diagnostic predictions along with confidence scores. By combining high diagnostic accuracy, computational efficiency, and practical usability, PulmoDiagAI offers a reliable decision-support system capable of assisting radiologists and clinicians in the early detection of pulmonary diseases, ultimately contributing to improved diagnostic workflows and patient outcomes.
items.summary_zh: PulmoDiagAI 比较 VGG19、ResNet50、MobileNetV3、EfficientNet-B3 和 DenseNet121，在公开胸部影像数据集上进行肺癌和 COVID‑19 分类。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 提供了统一预处理和多架构比较，并给出可部署 GUI；但证据主要来自公开基准数据集和 preprint，尚不足以证明真实临床环境中的泛化或诊断获益。
items.abstract_zh: 摘要：肺癌和 Coronavirus Disease 2019（COVID‑19）仍是全球呼吸系统相关发病和死亡的主要原因之一，凸显了对快速、准确和自动化诊断方案的迫切需求。本研究提出 PulmoDiagAI，这是一种智能计算机辅助诊断（CAD）系统，整合先进的深度学习技术，从胸部 X 射线和计算机断层扫描（CT）图像中自动检测和分类肺部疾病。研究对五种预训练卷积神经网络（CNN）架构，即 VGG19、ResNet50、MobileNetV3、EfficientNet-B3 和 DenseNet121，采用迁移学习策略进行微调，以确定每项诊断任务中最有效的模型。研究采用了包括图像标准化、中值滤波、调整大小、强度归一化和对比度受限自适应直方图均衡化（CLAHE）在内的综合预处理流程，以改善图像质量和特征提取。所提出的框架在两个公开基准数据集上评估：用于肺癌检测的 IQ-OTH/NCCD 和用于 COVID‑19 诊断的 COVID-QU-Ex。实验结果显示，EfficientNet-B3 在 COVID‑19 分类中表现最佳，准确率达到 97.0%，AUC-ROC 达到 99.43%。在肺癌检测中，MobileNetV3 和 ResNet50 分别达到 99.0% 和 98.0% 的准确率，AUC-ROC 均为 100%。为促进临床采用，研究将所提模型部署为直观的图形用户界面（GUI），能够提供实时诊断预测和置信度分数。PulmoDiagAI 将较高的诊断准确率、计算效率和实际可用性结合起来，可作为辅助放射科医师和临床医生早期检测肺部疾病的决策支持系统，并有望改善诊断流程和患者结局。

items.title: PedDx: An End-to-End Deep Learning Framework for Pediatric Posterior Fossa Tumor Diagnosis with Agentic AI-Enabled Independent External Evaluation
items.abstract_or_text: Reliable clinical translation of diagnostic artificial intelligence (AI) requires evaluation beyond classification accuracy. We developed PedDx, a segmentation-free framework for pediatric posterior fossa tumor diagnosis using T2-weighted MRI, pretrained 3DINO representations, calibrated predictions, and confidence-based abstention. Evaluation included 492 discovery, 114 replication, 129 external validation, and 40 independently tested cases, alongside 236 out-of-distribution (OOD) cases and controlled imaging perturbations. Classification accuracy was 79.8% in replication and 81.4% in external validation, increasing to 90.5% and 88.7%, respectively, among non-abstained cases. OOD analyses revealed performance degradation and confidently incorrect predictions, while perturbation analyses identified acquisition and alignment vulnerabilities. An external institution independently executed the complete agentic workflow, successfully generating predictions and structured quality-control reports for all 40 cases, with classification accuracy of 92.5%, increasing to 97.3% among non-abstained cases. PedDx demonstrates how uncertainty assessment, failure-mode characterization, external validation, and independently reproducible, traceable reporting can collectively inform the reliability and limitations of diagnostic AI systems.
items.summary_zh: PedDx 使用 T2 加权 MRI、预训练 3DINO 表征、校准预测和置信度弃答，并在复现、外部验证、分布外和独立机构工作流中评估儿科后颅窝肿瘤诊断。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 把弃答、失败模式、外部验证和独立可复现报告纳入诊断 AI 评估，明确展示了分布外性能下降和高置信错误。
items.abstract_zh: 可靠地将诊断人工智能（AI）转化到临床，需要超越分类准确率的评估。我们开发了 PedDx，这是一种无需分割的儿科后颅窝肿瘤诊断框架，使用 T2 加权 MRI、预训练 3DINO 表征、校准预测和基于置信度的弃答。评估包括 492 例发现集、114 例复现集、129 例外部验证集和 40 例独立测试病例，同时还包括 236 例分布外（OOD）病例和受控影像扰动。复现集和外部验证集的分类准确率分别为 79.8% 和 81.4%；在未弃答病例中，准确率分别升至 90.5% 和 88.7%。OOD 分析显示性能下降和高置信度错误预测，扰动分析发现了图像采集和配准方面的脆弱性。外部机构独立执行完整的智能体工作流，对全部 40 例病例成功生成预测和结构化质量控制报告；分类准确率为 92.5%，在未弃答病例中升至 97.3%。PedDx 展示了如何通过不确定性评估、失败模式刻画、外部验证以及独立、可复现且可追溯的报告，共同评估诊断 AI 系统的可靠性和局限性。

items.title: Few-shot regulatory sequence design with a genomic language model
items.abstract_or_text: A central challenge in generative biology is translating knowledge learned from natural sequences and experiments into designs with desired functions. In-context learning (ICL) is an emergent capability of large language models that allows them to adapt to new tasks from a few examples without additional training, enabling these models to become general-purpose learners. Here, we show that the genome language model, Evo 2, exhibits generative ICL in biological sequence design. Prompting with just tens of examples conditions Evo 2 to generate novel and diverse regulatory DNA sequences without any additional training. Mechanistic analysis suggests that genomic ICL may originate from induction, similar to phenomena observed in natural language. Reinforcement learning leveraging sequence-to-function models as experiment-derived rewards further strengthens ICL. We first validate this approach by generating enhancers that drive cell-type-specific gene expression in three human cell lines. Extending this approach in vivo, enhancers designed using human regulatory element data selectively label layer 5 extratelencephalic neurons in the mouse cortex with high specificity and stronger activity than existing enhancers. Our study provides evidence of emergent properties in genomic sequence models and introduces a promising approach for improving functional conditioning in generative biology.
items.summary_zh: Evo 2 仅用几十个示例即可进行基因组序列的上下文学习，生成调控 DNA 序列，并在三种人源细胞系和小鼠皮层体内验证增强子功能。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 将少样本基因组语言模型生成与序列到功能奖励、细胞实验和体内验证连接起来；目前仍是 preprint，机制解释和跨物种泛化仍需独立验证。
items.abstract_zh: 生成生物学的一个核心挑战，是将从天然序列和实验中学习到的知识转化为具有所需功能的设计。上下文学习（ICL）是大型语言模型的一种涌现能力，使模型能够从少量示例中适应新任务而无需额外训练，从而成为通用学习器。在这里，我们展示基因组语言模型 Evo 2 在生物序列设计中表现出生成式 ICL。只需提供几十个示例进行提示，即可在无需额外训练的情况下使 Evo 2 生成新颖且多样的调控 DNA 序列。机制分析提示，基因组 ICL 可能源于类似自然语言中所观察到的归纳现象。利用序列到功能模型作为实验衍生奖励的强化学习进一步增强了 ICL。我们首先通过生成能够在三种人源细胞系中驱动细胞类型特异性基因表达的增强子来验证该方法。进一步在体内，利用人类调控元件数据设计的增强子能够以高特异性标记小鼠皮层中的第 5 层端脑外神经元，其活性强于现有增强子。本研究为基因组序列模型中的涌现性质提供了证据，并提出了一种改进生成生物学功能条件化的潜在方法。

items.title: Fu-TCM: a multimodal large language model that learns traditional Chinese medicine diagnostic reasoning
items.abstract_or_text: Large language models (LLMs) are advancing in multimodal understanding and reasoning, accelerating medical model development. Traditional Chinese medicine (TCM) uses evidence from the four examinations to determine disease location and nature, differentiate syndromes and guide treatment. This diagnostic process constitutes a complete chain of reasoning. We present Fu-TCM, a multimodal TCM LLM trained on data retained after cleaning and filtering an initial collection of approximately 7.12 million examples derived from classical texts, textbooks, medical images, clinical cases and publicly available datasets. The model was further optimized using Bianzheng-Grounded Policy Optimization (BGPO), which explicitly targets syndrome differentiation through rewards for response format, intermediate TCM reasoning fields and final syndrome predictions. Fu-TCM-27B led all six benchmarks spanning TCM reasoning, text and vision, achieving a macro-average accuracy of 81.01% and surpassing the strongest reference model with complete results across all six benchmarks by 7.13 percentage points. Its largest margin was 11.90 points on Fu-bianzheng. Case-level analyses further showed a positive association between intermediate-field accuracy and final syndrome-selection accuracy in most evaluated models. These findings suggest that TCM syndrome differentiation may be computationally learnable and that structured reasoning supervision can improve performance across TCM tasks.
items.summary_zh: Fu-TCM 在约 712 万条清洗前样本基础上训练多模态中医大模型，并用 BGPO 对辨证推理进行结构化监督，在六个基准上取得 81.01% 宏平均准确率。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 展示了大规模多模态医学数据和结构化中间推理监督的组合效果；这是 preprint，基准性能不等于真实临床诊断有效性。
items.abstract_zh: 大型语言模型（LLM）正在推进多模态理解和推理，加速医学模型开发。中医利用望、闻、问、切四诊证据来判断疾病部位和性质、辨别证候并指导治疗，这一诊断过程构成完整的推理链。我们提出 Fu-TCM，这是一种多模态中医 LLM，使用从约 7.12 million 条由经典文献、教科书、医学图像、临床病例和公开数据集组成的初始数据中清洗和筛选后保留的数据进行训练。随后，模型通过辨证论治导向的策略优化（Bianzheng-Grounded Policy Optimization，BGPO）进一步优化；该方法通过对回答格式、中医中间推理字段和最终证候预测给予奖励，明确针对证候辨识进行优化。Fu-TCM-27B 在涵盖中医推理、文本和视觉的六项基准测试中均排名第一，宏平均准确率为 81.01%，比在六项基准上都有完整结果的最强参考模型高 7.13 个百分点。在 Fu-bianzheng 上的最大优势为 11.90 个百分点。病例级分析进一步显示，在大多数被评估模型中，中间字段准确率与最终证候选择准确率呈正相关。这些结果提示，中医证候辨识可能可以通过计算学习，结构化推理监督可能提升模型在不同中医任务上的表现。

items.title: Comparative Proteomics Reveals Cell-Type-Specific Heterogeneity of Human Neural Cell-Derived Extracellular Vesicles
items.abstract_or_text: Extracellular vesicles (EVs) are increasingly explored as biomarkers and as drug delivery vehicles for the brain, yet how EV cargo differs among neural cell types at baseline remains poorly defined. This gap limits both the interpretation of disease-associated EV changes and the rational choice of EV source for therapeutic use. Here, we compared EVs from human neuronal-like SH-SY5Y cells (N-EV), astrocytes (AS-EV), and HMC3 microglia (MG-EV) side by side using tandem mass tag (TMT)-based quantitative proteomics, with all samples analyzed in a single multiplexed batch. EV identity was supported by TEM, nanoparticle tracking analysis, and canonical MISEV2023 markers. Size, zeta potential, and protein content per vesicle were comparable across EV types, whereas N-EV showed the highest particle concentration and protein yield. Enrichment analyses and consensus clustering showed cargo consistent with parental-cell functions: neuronal connectivity and structural remodeling in N-EV, extracellular support and cellular interaction in AS-EV, and immune surveillance in MG-EV. Cross-comparison also revealed patterns beyond these canonical roles, including complement-associated cargo shared by N-EV and MG-EV and a Glial-EV signature of chromatin-associated and epigenetic regulatory proteins shared by AS-EV and MG-EV. We further defined cell-type-specific signature proteins; interaction networks of the larger sets were consistent with the enrichment results. Overall, these data provide a baseline comparative reference of EV proteomes from human neural cell models for interpreting disease-associated alterations, selecting EV sources for therapeutic use, and generating hypotheses on selective cargo sorting.
items.summary_zh: TMT 定量蛋白质组学比较神经元样细胞、星形胶质细胞和小胶质细胞来源细胞外囊泡，解析细胞类型特异性货物及共享信号。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 在单一多重批次中建立人源神经细胞模型 EV 蛋白质组基线，可支持疾病相关变化解释和治疗性 EV 来源选择；仍需原代细胞和体内验证。
items.abstract_zh: 细胞外囊泡（EV）正越来越多地被探索为脑部生物标志物和药物递送载体，但不同神经细胞类型在基线状态下的 EV 货物如何差异，仍缺乏明确认识。这一空白限制了对疾病相关 EV 变化的解释，也限制了对治疗用途 EV 来源的理性选择。在本研究中，我们使用串联质谱标签（TMT）定量蛋白质组学，在单一多重批次中并行比较人神经元样 SH-SY5Y 细胞（N-EV）、星形胶质细胞（AS-EV）和 HMC3 小胶质细胞（MG-EV）来源的 EV。透射电子显微镜（TEM）、纳米颗粒跟踪分析以及经典 MISEV2023 标志物支持 EV 身份。不同 EV 类型的大小、zeta 电位和每个囊泡的蛋白质含量相近，而 N-EV 的颗粒浓度和蛋白质产量最高。富集分析和共识聚类显示，货物与亲本细胞功能一致：N-EV 富集神经元连接和结构重塑相关货物，AS-EV 富集细胞外支持和细胞相互作用相关货物，MG-EV 富集免疫监视相关货物。跨类型比较还发现超出这些经典功能的模式，包括 N-EV 与 MG-EV 共有的补体相关货物，以及 AS-EV 与 MG-EV 共有的染色质相关和表观遗传调控蛋白组成的 Glial-EV 特征。我们进一步定义了细胞类型特异性标志蛋白；较大蛋白集合的相互作用网络与富集结果一致。总体而言，这些数据提供了人神经细胞模型 EV 蛋白质组的比较基线，可用于解释疾病相关变化、选择治疗性 EV 来源，并提出选择性货物分选的研究假设。

items.title: TRACER, a time-to-event EHR foundation model for disease detection across health systems
items.abstract_or_text: Foundation models trained on longitudinal electronic health records (EHRs) can predict clinical diagnoses years in the future, making them a potential tool for disease screening. We developed TRACER (Temporal Risk Assessment with Clinical EHR Representations), a decoder-based foundation model pretrained on data from over 4.5 million patients from four health systems, and evaluated it on 16 incident diseases at 1-, 2-, and 5-year horizons in more than 2 million patients from two health systems excluded from model development. In contrast to typical evaluations that focus on global metrics (e.g., AUROC), we measured performance at the low false-positive rates that are realistic for screening. We found that TRACER retained its discrimination in external health systems, and at 95% specificity, the patients it flagged were up to eight times more likely to be diagnosed within a year than unselected patients. Evaluating at this operating point also revealed what global metrics alone did not: detection and false-alert burden varied across diseases and health systems, even when discrimination appeared stable. Our results illustrate the potential of foundation models for screening and underscore the need for evaluation in health systems excluded from development to assess disease detection and false-alert burden at levels appropriate for intended clinical use.}
items.summary_zh: TRACER 在四个医疗系统超过 450 万患者数据上预训练，并在两个未参与开发的系统、超过 200 万患者中，以低假阳性率评估 16 种疾病的 1、2 和 5 年检测。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 将跨医疗系统外部验证与筛查所需的低假阳性率结合，显示全局 AUROC 之外的疾病和系统差异；仍需前瞻性临床评估。
items.abstract_zh: 在纵向电子健康记录（EHR）上训练的基础模型可以预测数年后的临床诊断，因此可能成为疾病筛查工具。我们开发了 TRACER（Temporal Risk Assessment with Clinical EHR Representations），这是一种基于解码器的基础模型，在来自四个医疗系统的超过 4.5 million 名患者数据上预训练；随后在两个未参与模型开发的医疗系统中、超过 2 million 名患者上，对 16 种发病疾病在 1 年、2 年和 5 年时间范围进行评估。不同于只关注全局指标（例如 AUROC）的常见评估，我们在适合筛查的低假阳性率下测量性能。结果显示，TRACER 在外部医疗系统中保持了区分能力；在 95% 特异度下，它标记的患者在一年内被诊断的可能性最高是未筛选患者的八倍。以这一工作点进行评估还揭示了仅靠全局指标无法看到的现象：即使区分能力看起来稳定，不同疾病和医疗系统的检出率及假警报负担仍会变化。我们的结果展示了基础模型用于筛查的潜力，并强调需要在模型开发中排除的医疗系统中进行评估，以便在符合预期临床用途的水平上考察疾病检出和假警报负担。
items.author_line: Mara Pleasure, Ekaterina Redekop, Vedrana Ivezic, Rushikesh Kulkarni, Aaron Chin, William Speier, Corey W. Arnold

items.title: An Integrated Miniaturized Metabologenomics Workflow for High-Throughput Actinomycetes Prioritization
items.abstract_or_text: Antibiotic resistance is a growing global health threat, while the discovery of new antimicrobial agents remains constrained by labor-intensive cultivation, extraction, and screening workflows. We developed a miniaturized, high-throughput metabologenomics workflow integrating Duetz system-based microfermentation, extraction-free UHPLC-HRMS/MS profiling, antibacterial screening, and genome mining. A collection of 80 soil-derived actinomycetes was screened against clinically relevant pathogens, identifying seven isolates active against methicillin-resistant Staphylococcus aureus (MRSA), Enterococcus faecium, or both. All isolates were cultivated in Duetz system-based microfermentation plates, and cell-free culture filtrates were analyzed directly by UHPLC-HRMS/MS without solvent extraction. Compared with a conventional workflow, the approach reduced culture-medium consumption by approximately 99%, decreased recurring consumable costs by approximately 96%, and reduced the time required to obtain LC-MS-ready samples from typically 5 days to approximately 20 min. Integration of antibacterial, metabolomic, and genomic datasets supported the annotation of diverse metabolite families, including actinomycins, polyether ionophores, ansamycins, angucyclines, hydroxamate siderophores, ectoines, tambromycin-associated metabolites, and putative lydicamycin metabolites. Selected annotations were validated using commercial standards. Overall, this study demonstrates that integrating miniaturized Duetz system-based cultivation, extraction-free metabolomics, antibacterial screening, and genome mining provides a scalable, robust, and cost-effective platform for high-throughput strain prioritization and natural product discovery.
items.summary_zh: 整合 Duetz 微发酵、无提取 UHPLC-HRMS/MS、抗菌筛选和基因组挖掘，在 80 株放线菌中筛出 7 株对 MRSA、Enterococcus faecium 或两者有活性的菌株。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 把微型化培养、代谢组学和基因组学整合为高通量天然产物优先级筛选流程，显著降低耗材和时间成本，并对部分注释使用商业标准验证。
items.abstract_zh: 抗生素耐药性正在成为日益严重的全球健康威胁，而新型抗菌剂的发现仍受培养、提取和筛选流程劳动密集的限制。我们开发了一种微型化、高通量代谢组基因组学流程，整合基于 Duetz 系统的微发酵、无需提取的 UHPLC-HRMS/MS 分析、抗菌筛选和基因组挖掘。我们筛选了 80 株来源于土壤的放线菌，使其与临床相关病原体进行对抗，鉴定出 7 株对耐甲氧西林金黄色葡萄球菌（MRSA）、Enterococcus faecium 或两者有活性的菌株。所有菌株均在基于 Duetz 系统的微发酵板中培养，随后直接对无细胞培养滤液进行 UHPLC-HRMS/MS 分析，无需溶剂提取。与传统流程相比，该方法使培养基消耗量减少约 99%，经常性耗材成本降低约 96%，并将获得可进行 LC-MS 分析样品所需的时间从通常 5 天缩短至约 20 分钟。整合抗菌、代谢组和基因组数据支持对多类代谢物的注释，包括 actinomycins、polyether ionophores、ansamycins、angucyclines、hydroxamate siderophores、ectoines、tambromycin-associated metabolites 以及推定的 lydicamycin metabolites。部分注释使用商业标准进行了验证。总体而言，本研究表明，将基于 Duetz 系统的微型化培养、无提取代谢组学、抗菌筛选和基因组挖掘结合起来，可形成用于高通量菌株优先级排序和天然产物发现的可扩展、稳健且经济的平台。

items.title: Alpha- and Gamma-Synuclein Proteins Define Complementary Metabolic and Invasive Programs in Melanoma Development, Progression, and Prognosis
items.abstract_or_text: Abstract Melanoma, a highly aggressive skin cancer, remains a major clinical challenge due to its metastatic capacity and resistance to therapy. Synuclein proteins — alpha-synuclein (αS) and gamma-synuclein (γS), traditionally studied in neurodegeneration — are increasingly recognized as contributors to melanoma progression, yet whether they define distinct tumor cell states or act through shared mechanisms remains unclear. Here, we show that SNCA and SNCG are robustly anti-correlated across independent transcriptomic and proteomic cohorts and at single-cell resolution, marking two complementary malignant cell states. Both synucleins support melanoma proliferation, migration, and invasion, and are internalized by melanoma cells in a prion-like manner that enhances tumor growth in vitro and in vivo. Functionally, however, αS and γS diverge along distinct axes. αS is transcriptionally coupled to a MITF-linked mitochondrial program and functionally sensitizes complex I: its silencing improves mitochondrial bioenergetics and blunts the response to a second respiratory challenge, while exogenous fibrils impair it, alongside a corresponding shift in pigmentation. γS instead sustains an integrin-FAK-Rac1-MAPK signaling axis and β-catenin regulation that drives invasive behavior; its silencing reduces MAPK output and confers cross-resistance to three mechanistically distinct therapeutic agents — cisplatin, vemurafenib, and paclitaxel. These opposing programs converge on a shared differentiation axis: SNCG-high cells define a dedifferentiated, MITF-low, invasive malignant subpopulation that is independently associated with shorter progression-free interval in stage IIC melanoma. Collectively, these findings establish αS and γS as functionally distinct, mechanistically convergent regulators of a metabolic-versus-invasive cell-state dichotomy in melanoma, nominate SNCG as a candidate prognostic biomarker, and identify complex I sensitization and FAK/MAPK signaling as candidate therapeutic vulnerabilities.
items.summary_zh: 在转录组、蛋白质组和单细胞层面，研究显示 SNCA 与 SNCG 标记黑色素瘤中互补的恶性细胞状态，并分别关联线粒体代谢和侵袭信号。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 把单细胞状态、功能扰动、体内实验和多队列临床关联结合起来，提出 SNCG、复合体 I 和 FAK/MAPK 作为候选生物标志物或脆弱性；摘要支持机制线索，不等同于临床因果证据。
items.abstract_zh: 摘要：黑色素瘤是一种高度侵袭性的皮肤癌，其转移能力和治疗耐药性仍构成重大临床挑战。突触核蛋白 α（αS）和突触核蛋白 γ（γS）传统上主要在神经退行性疾病中研究，但越来越多证据表明它们参与黑色素瘤进展；然而，它们是否定义不同的肿瘤细胞状态，或通过共享机制发挥作用，仍不清楚。在这里，我们显示 SNCA 和 SNCG 在独立的转录组和蛋白质组队列中，以及在单细胞分辨率下，呈稳健的反相关，标记两种互补的恶性细胞状态。两种突触核蛋白都支持黑色素瘤增殖、迁移和侵袭，并以类朊病毒方式被黑色素瘤细胞内化，从而增强体外和体内肿瘤生长。然而，在功能上，αS 和 γS 沿不同轴线分化。αS 在转录上与 MITF 相关的线粒体程序耦联，并使复合体 I 对功能刺激敏感：沉默 αS 可改善线粒体生物能量学并削弱细胞对第二次呼吸挑战的反应，而外源性纤维则损害该过程，同时伴随色素沉着变化。γS 则维持由整合素-FAK-Rac1-MAPK 信号轴和 β-catenin 调控的程序，驱动侵袭行为；沉默 γS 可降低 MAPK 输出，并赋予细胞对三种机制不同的治疗药物——cisplatin、vemurafenib 和 paclitaxel——的交叉耐药性。这些相反的程序汇聚于共同的分化轴：SNCG-high 细胞定义了去分化、MITF-low、侵袭性的恶性亚群；在 IIC 期黑色素瘤中，该亚群与较短的无进展间期独立相关。总之，本研究确定 αS 和 γS 是代谢型与侵袭型细胞状态二分的功能不同但机制汇聚的调节因子，提出 SNCG 作为候选预后生物标志物，并将复合体 I 敏化和 FAK/MAPK 信号确定为候选治疗脆弱性。

items.title: Agentic LLM reasoning in pediatric diabetes outcome prediction from multimodal medical records
items.abstract_or_text: Large language model (LLM) agents are proposed for clinical prediction but are untested in pediatrics, where cohorts are small and outcomes are uncommon. Using records from 2,489 youth with type 2 diabetes (T2D) and 4,018 with type 1 diabetes (T1D), spanning structured data, note-derived social determinants and, in T1D, continuous glucose monitoring data, we predicted seven T2D outcomes, four also in T1D, at 24 months from 18 months of follow-up. CEDAR (Clinical Evidence-Driven Agent for Risk-prediction), an evidence-citing, self-auditing LLM pipeline, outperformed trained machine learning in both cohorts (pooled area under the receiver operating characteristic curve 0.815 versus 0.656 to 0.700 in T2D and 0.756 versus 0.603 to 0.631 in T1D), most on the sparsely screened outcomes. Only 4 of 70,246 values it cited did not match the chart. Reading only the evidence and reasoning cited by CEDAR, two pediatric endocrinologists reached the same prediction as CEDAR in about nine of ten cases, agreeing with each other on 90.5%.
items.summary_zh: CEDAR 是可引用证据、自审计的 LLM 流程，在 2489 名 T2D 和 4018 名 T1D 青少年记录上预测 24 个月结局，并与传统机器学习及儿科内分泌专家判断比较。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 将证据引用和自审计纳入儿科预测，在稀疏筛查结局上优于比较模型，并显示专家仅阅读引用证据即可复核；这是 preprint，仍需前瞻性验证。
items.abstract_zh: 大型语言模型（LLM）智能体被提出用于临床预测，但尚未在儿科中得到充分检验；儿科队列通常较小，结局也不常见。我们使用 2,489 名 2 型糖尿病（T2D）青少年和 4,018 名 1 型糖尿病（T1D）青少年的记录，这些记录涵盖结构化数据、从病历笔记中提取的社会决定因素以及 T1D 中的连续血糖监测数据；我们根据 18 个月随访预测 24 个月时的 7 个 T2D 结局，其中 4 个结局也在 T1D 中预测。CEDAR（Clinical Evidence-Driven Agent for Risk-prediction）是一种会引用证据并进行自我审计的 LLM 流程，在两个队列中均优于训练得到的机器学习模型：T2D 队列的合并受试者工作特征曲线下面积为 0.815，而比较模型为 0.656 至 0.700；T1D 队列为 0.756，而比较模型为 0.603 至 0.631；优势在筛查较少的结局上最明显。在其引用的 70,246 个数值中，仅有 4 个与病历不一致。两名儿科内分泌科医师仅阅读 CEDAR 引用的证据和推理，在约九成病例中得出了与 CEDAR 相同的预测；两位医师彼此的一致率为 90.5%。

items.title: QUARTZ: Cross-Dataset Artificial Intelligence-Enabled Retinal Vasculometry
creators: UK Biobank Eye and Vision Consortium,
items.abstract_or_text: Examination of retinal images provides a non-invasive means to assess the body's microvascular system, with vessel morphology linked to ocular and systemic diseases. QUARTZ (QUantitative Analysis of Retinal vessel Topology and siZe) is an automated, artificial intelligence-enabled retinal vasculometry system designed for processing large-scale retinal image datasets, including over 4 million images from within the National Health Service, to facilitate epidemiological studies. The system is uniquely capable of extracting useful information from lower quality images, including those which are partially illuminated, enabling analysis of a greater proportion of images. To enhance cross-dataset generalisation of the system from an earlier dataset-tailored approach, this work leverages 26 annotated retinal image datasets spanning diverse demographics, diseases, camera types, and imaging protocols. Evaluation on the external EPIC-Norfolk dataset demonstrates robust performance with F1 scores of 0.8305, 0.8477, 0.8741, 0.9532, and 0.8677 for arteriole, venule, vessel, optic disc, and optic cup segmentation, respectively, and 0.9197 for image quality classification. The cross-dataset generalisation approach demonstrated increased performance for arteriole/venule segmentation and optic disc segmentation. However, improvements in performance were not observed for optic cup segmentation, or for image quality classification. An online tool is provided to support wider adoption and reproducible biomarker research across diverse populations and imaging settings. In addition, the new public CHASE-AV database is introduced for arteriole and venule segmentation.
items.summary_zh: QUARTZ 在 26 个标注视网膜数据集上进行跨数据集泛化，并在 EPIC-Norfolk 外部数据上评估血管、视盘和视杯分割，覆盖 NHS 超过 400 万张图像。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 跨人群、相机和成像协议的泛化、公开 CHASE-AV 数据库和在线工具增强了可复现性；部分任务未改善，提示部署前仍需分任务校准。
items.abstract_zh: 视网膜图像检查提供了一种无创评估全身微血管系统的方式，血管形态与眼部和全身疾病相关。QUARTZ（QUantitative Analysis of Retinal vessel Topology and siZe）是一种自动化、由人工智能支持的视网膜血管测量系统，旨在处理大规模视网膜图像数据集，包括来自 National Health Service 的超过 4 million 张图像，以支持流行病学研究。该系统能够从较低质量的图像中提取有用信息，包括部分受照明影响的图像，从而分析更大比例的图像。为增强系统相对于早期数据集定制方法的跨数据集泛化能力，本研究使用了 26 个标注视网膜图像数据集，这些数据集覆盖不同人群、疾病、相机类型和成像协议。在外部 EPIC-Norfolk 数据集上的评估显示，细动脉、细静脉、血管、视盘和视杯分割的 F1 分数分别为 0.8305、0.8477、0.8741、0.9532 和 0.8677，图像质量分类的 F1 分数为 0.9197。跨数据集泛化方法提高了细动脉/细静脉分割和视盘分割性能，但视杯分割和图像质量分类没有观察到性能改善。研究提供了在线工具，以支持不同人群和成像环境下更广泛的采用和可复现的生物标志物研究。此外，还建立了新的公开 CHASE-AV 数据库，用于细动脉和细静脉分割。

items.title: Explainable Protein Language Model Embeddings for Rapid Antibiotic Resistance Gene Classification
items.abstract_or_text: Abstract Antimicrobial resistance (AMR) is a major public-health threat because resistant infections narrow therapeutic options, delay effective treatment, and increase the clinical and economic burden of bacterial disease. Conventional phenotypic susceptibility testing remains essential but requires 24–48 hours after isolate growth, while sequence-based interpretation requires curated databases and bioinformatics expertise. This paper presents ResiScan, an explainable machine-learning framework for rapid classification of antibiotic resistance genes from protein sequences. The proposed system uses the Comprehensive Antibiotic Resistance Database (CARD) protein homolog model data and extracts contextual protein representations with the pre-trained ESM2 model. Each protein sequence is tokenized, truncated to 512 residues for computational consistency, passed through ESM2, and represented by a 320-dimensional mean-pooled embedding. A logistic regression classifier is trained on these embeddings, with the Synthetic Minority Oversampling Technique (SMOTE) applied only to the training partition to address severe class imbalance across five target resistance classes: beta-lactam, aminoglycoside, macrolide, tetracycline, and vancomycin. The framework further integrates SHAP-based feature attribution to expose which embedding dimensions contribute most strongly to each prediction, and provides an interactive Gradio web interface for non-specialist use. The prototype achieves 99.25% accuracy and a macro-F1 score of 0.9507 on a held-out test set of 400 protein sequences, demonstrating a practical balance among speed, interpretability, and deployability.
items.summary_zh: ResiScan 用 ESM2 蛋白质语言模型嵌入和 SHAP 归因，对五类抗生素耐药基因进行快速分类，在 400 条留出蛋白序列上达到 99.25% 准确率。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 将蛋白质语言模型表示、类别不平衡处理、可解释性和轻量部署结合起来，适合作为快速筛查基线；但测试集规模有限，需独立序列和实验耐药表型验证。
items.abstract_zh: 摘要：抗微生物药物耐药性（AMR）是重大公共卫生威胁，因为耐药感染会缩小治疗选择、延迟有效治疗，并增加细菌性疾病的临床和经济负担。传统表型药敏试验仍然必不可少，但在分离株生长后需要 24–48 小时；基于序列的解释则需要经过整理的数据库和生物信息学专业知识。本文提出 ResiScan，这是一种可解释的机器学习框架，用于从蛋白质序列中快速分类抗生素耐药基因。所提出的系统使用 Comprehensive Antibiotic Resistance Database（CARD）的蛋白质同源模型数据，并通过预训练 ESM2 提取具有上下文信息的蛋白质表示。每条蛋白质序列被标记化，并截断至 512 个残基以保持计算一致性，随后输入 ESM2，并表示为 320 维平均池化嵌入。研究在这些嵌入上训练逻辑回归分类器，并仅在训练分区应用合成少数类过采样技术（SMOTE），以处理五类目标耐药类别之间严重的类别不平衡：β-lactam、aminoglycoside、macrolide、tetracycline 和 vancomycin。该框架进一步整合基于 SHAP 的特征归因，以揭示哪些嵌入维度对各项预测贡献最大，并提供面向非专业用户的交互式 Gradio 网页界面。该原型在包含 400 条蛋白质序列的留出测试集上达到 99.25% 的准确率和 0.9507 的宏 F1 分数，显示出速度、可解释性和可部署性之间的实用平衡。
