items.title: Extensive and heterogeneous viral circular RNA production during Zika virus infection
items.abstract_or_text: Circular RNAs (circRNAs) are covalently closed RNA molecules with regulatory functions. Although virus-derived circRNAs (vcircRNAs) are well characterized in DNA viruses, their occurrence in RNA viruses remains poorly understood. Recent reports in coronaviruses and hepatitis C virus suggest that vcircRNA production extends beyond nuclear-replicating viruses. Here, we show that Zika virus (ZIKV), a vector-borne orthoflavivirus, produces vcircRNAs during infection of neural stem cells. Using a custom computational pipeline optimized for viral back-splice junction detection, we identified at 72 hours post infection a core set of 113 putative vcircRNAs shared across three biological replicates and distributed throughout the viral genome. Eight candidates spanning different genomic regions and abundance levels were experimentally validated by rolling-circle reverse transcription and Nanopore sequencing. These findings provide the first evidence of vcircRNA production in an orthoflavivirus, suggesting that circular RNA biogenesis may represent a previously underappreciated feature of RNA virus biology.
items.summary_zh: 在神经干细胞感染模型中，计算流程发现三次生物学重复共有 113 个 ZIKV 环状 RNA 候选，并用滚环逆转录和 Nanopore 测序验证其中 8 个。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 为正链 RNA 病毒产生病毒来源 circRNA 提供了实验支持，拓展了对 ZIKV RNA 生物学的认识；候选功能和普遍性仍需进一步研究。
items.abstract_zh: 环状 RNA（circRNA）是具有调控功能的共价闭合 RNA 分子。尽管病毒来源的 circRNA（vcircRNA）在 DNA 病毒中已有充分表征，但其在 RNA 病毒中的出现仍知之甚少。近期关于冠状病毒和 hepatitis C virus 的报道提示，vcircRNA 的产生并不局限于在细胞核内复制的病毒。在这里，我们显示 Zika virus（ZIKV）这种由媒介传播的正黄病毒，在感染神经干细胞期间会产生 vcircRNA。利用针对病毒反向剪接连接检测进行优化的定制计算流程，我们在感染后 72 小时识别出一组核心的 113 个推定 vcircRNA；它们在三次生物学重复中均出现，并分布于整个病毒基因组。我们使用滚环逆转录和 Nanopore 测序，对覆盖不同基因组区域和丰度水平的 8 个候选进行了实验验证。这些发现为正黄病毒中产生 vcircRNA 提供了首个证据，提示环状 RNA 生物发生可能是 RNA 病毒生物学中此前被低估的特征。
items.author_line: Stradiotto, M., Vezzi, A., Vardeu, M., Mercorelli, B., Vogiatzis, S., Loregian, A., Barzon, L., Toppo, S., Lavezzo, E., Trevisan, M.

items.title: Biopsy-Validated Deep Learning Mapping of Glioma Infiltration Beyond Contrast Enhancement Using Multiparametric MRI
items.abstract_or_text: Background: Glioblastoma (GBM) exhibits diffuse tumor infiltration beyond contrast-enhancing margins into FLAIR-hyperintense brain tissue, where infiltrative tumor is not visible on conventional MRI. We developed and validated the infiltrative Tumor Burden (iTB) map, a deep learning biomarker that uses multiparametric MRI (mpMRI) to identify infiltrative tumor within these non-enhancing regions. Methods: Preoperative mpMRI datasets from 80 patients with WHO grade II-IV gliomas and 24 patients with brain metastases were retrospectively analyzed. Imaging included pre- and post-contrast T1-weighted, T2-weighted, FLAIR, dynamic susceptibility contrast perfusion and diffusion MRI-derived maps (rCBV, rCBF, ADC). Spatially localized stereotactic biopsies from non-enhancing glioma regions provided histopathologic ground truth while peritumoral brain metastasis regions served as biologically grounded non-tumor controls. A 3D convolutional neural network was trained on voxel-centered mpMRI patches using patient-level cross-validation and an independent test set, with data augmentation optimized using a greedy local search strategy. Results: Model development included 121 biopsy-localized samples from 56 glioma patients and 104 non-tumor samples from 26 brain metastasis patients. Augmentation optimization significantly improved independent test-set performance, increasing accuracy from 74.5% to 85.5% and AUC from 0.859 to 0.942 (p = 0.008). Ensemble-derived voxel-wise iTB maps demonstrated low infiltration probabilities in brain metastases and extensive regions of elevated infiltration probability in glioblastoma, consistent with expected biology. Conclusions: The iTB biomarker generates voxel-wise maps of tumor infiltration within non-enhancing FLAIR abnormalities. Validated against image-localized histopathology and independent testing, it achieved high diagnostic performance and may improve surgical planning, radiotherapy targeting, and assessment of glioma burden.
items.summary_zh: iTB 深度学习图谱用多参数 MRI 识别非强化 FLAIR 异常中的胶质瘤浸润，并以空间定位活检组织学和脑转移瘤对照验证。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 把影像预测与活检定位的组织学真值和独立测试结合，提升了浸润检测性能；这是 preprint，能否改善手术或放疗决策仍需前瞻性研究。
items.abstract_zh: 背景：胶质母细胞瘤（GBM）会从对比增强边缘向外弥漫性浸润，进入 FLAIR 高信号脑组织，而常规 MRI 看不到其中的浸润性肿瘤。我们开发并验证了浸润性肿瘤负荷（infiltrative Tumor Burden，iTB）图谱，这是一种使用多参数 MRI（mpMRI）识别这些非强化区域内浸润性肿瘤的深度学习生物标志物。方法：我们回顾性分析了 80 名 WHO II–IV 级胶质瘤患者和 24 名脑转移瘤患者的术前 mpMRI 数据集。成像包括增强前和增强后的 T1 加权、T2 加权、FLAIR、动态磁敏感对比灌注以及由弥散 MRI 得到的图谱（rCBV、rCBF、ADC）。来自非强化胶质瘤区域的空间定位立体定向活检提供组织病理学真值，而脑转移瘤周围脑组织区域作为具有生物学依据的非肿瘤对照。我们使用患者级交叉验证和独立测试集，在以体素为中心的 mpMRI 图像块上训练 3D 卷积神经网络，并使用贪婪局部搜索策略优化数据增强。结果：模型开发包括来自 56 名胶质瘤患者的 121 个活检定位样本，以及来自 26 名脑转移瘤患者的 104 个非肿瘤样本。数据增强优化显著改善了独立测试集性能，使准确率从 74.5% 提高到 85.5%，AUC 从 0.859 提高到 0.942（p = 0.008）。集成模型得到的逐体素 iTB 图谱显示，脑转移瘤中的浸润概率较低，而胶质母细胞瘤中存在大范围浸润概率升高区域，与预期生物学一致。结论：iTB 生物标志物能够在非强化 FLAIR 异常中生成逐体素肿瘤浸润图谱。经影像定位的组织病理学和独立测试验证后，该方法取得较高诊断性能，可能改善手术规划、放疗靶区确定和胶质瘤负荷评估。
items.author_line: Wujek, R. T., Schmainda, K. M., Prah, M. A.

items.title: H^2R: Hierarchical Hint-Based Reward for Mathematical Reasoning via Reinforcement Learning
items.abstract_or_text: Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards has shown great promise in enhancing mathematical reasoning in large language models. However, existing approaches provide limited intermediate supervision for complex, multi-step reasoning tasks. To bridge this gap, we propose Hierarchical Hint-based Reward, a framework that leverages the intrinsic sub-question structure of mathematical problems as structured intermediate conditioning signals during RLVR training. Unlike chain-of-thought prompting, these hierarchical hints serve as logically grounded intermediate milestones that effectively reduce the reasoning horizon toward the final answer. To validate this framework, we introduce HiMath, a benchmark of hierarchically structured mathematical problems. Across diverse LLMs, hierarchical hints consistently improve reasoning performance even without task-specific training. When integrated into RL training via H^2R, they boost Qwen2.5-Math-7B accuracy on HiMath from 30.4\% to 39.1\% using hierarchical hints, and up to 45.6\% with Oracle Hierarchical Hints. This pronounced improvement demonstrates that incorporating reliable intermediate checkpoints into reward design is essential for sustaining complex mathematical reasoning.
items.summary_zh: 提出 H^2R 分层提示奖励框架，把数学题的子问题结构作为 RLVR 的中间监督，并发布 HiMath 基准。Qwen2.5-Math-7B 在 HiMath 上的准确率由 30.4% 提升至 39.1%，使用 Oracle 分层提示时达 45.6%。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 任务结构和中间检查点定义清晰，改进在专门基准上可复现；结果衡量的是基准准确率，不等同于通用数学证明能力。
items.abstract_zh: 带可验证奖励的强化学习已显示出增强大语言模型数学推理的潜力。然而，现有方法对复杂多步推理提供的中间监督有限。为弥补这一缺口，我们提出分层提示奖励（Hierarchical Hint-based Reward）框架，在 RLVR 训练中利用数学问题固有的子问题结构，将其作为结构化的中间条件信号。不同于思维链提示，这些分层提示是具有逻辑依据的中间里程碑，能够有效缩短通向最终答案的推理跨度。为验证该框架，我们引入 HiMath，一个具有层次结构的数学问题基准。在多种大语言模型上，即使不进行针对任务的训练，分层提示也能持续提升推理表现。将 H^2R 纳入强化学习后，Qwen2.5-Math-7B 在 HiMath 上的准确率从 30.4% 提升到 39.1%；使用 Oracle Hierarchical Hints 时最高达到 45.6%。这一明显改进表明，在奖励设计中加入可靠的中间检查点，对于维持复杂数学推理至关重要。
items.author_line: He Tu, Siye Li, Hongyi Wen

items.title: Ramanujan Challenge Results: AI-Assisted Evaluation Pipeline for Multi-Format Proofs
items.abstract_or_text: As AI's mathematical capabilities rapidly improve, meaningful benchmarks are shifting from university-level problems and math olympiads to research-level mathematics. The Ramanujan Challenge is a benchmark comprised of research-level problems in number theory, including unpublished results and open conjectures. It presented concrete formulas for mathematical constants whose correctness can be checked numerically, while their proofs may require non-obvious mathematics. Here, we analyze the Challenge submissions, measuring the relative success of different AI models, Computer Algebra Systems (CAS), and formal tools. We find correct submissions that are conceptually distinct from the official solutions, and a proof of one of the published open conjectures. Evaluating the submissions exposed a second challenge: judging complex proofs reliably at scale. We introduce an AI-assisted evaluation pipeline for natural language proofs, CAS code, and Lean formalizations that assesses semantic and logical correctness. Compared with the conventional one-shot LLM judgment, our pipeline reduces false-positive verdicts on natural language proofs from 23% to 6% and improves judgment accuracy on supporting code from 46% to 58%. This approach provides a methodology for evaluating research-level mathematics at scale, with potential applications across mathematics and AI for science.
items.summary_zh: 分析 Ramanujan Challenge 的研究级数论题提交结果，并提出覆盖自然语言证明、CAS 代码和 Lean 形式化的 AI 辅助评测流程。该流程将自然语言证明误报率从 23% 降至 6%，支持代码判断准确率从 46% 提升至 58%。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 同时比较模型、CAS 和形式化工具，并报告可量化的评测改进；研究级证明的自动判定仍需谨慎解读。
items.abstract_zh: 随着 AI 的数学能力迅速提升，有意义的基准正从大学程度的问题和数学奥林匹克题转向研究级数学。Ramanujan Challenge 是一个由数论研究级问题组成的基准，其中包括未发表的结果和开放猜想。该挑战给出了数学常数的具体公式，其正确性可以通过数值检查，而证明可能需要非显然的数学方法。在本文中，我们分析挑战提交结果，衡量不同 AI 模型、计算机代数系统（CAS）和形式化工具的相对成功率。我们发现了一些在概念上不同于官方解答的正确提交，并发现了一个已发表开放猜想的证明。对提交结果的评估还暴露出第二个挑战：如何可靠地大规模判断复杂证明。为此，我们提出一个面向自然语言证明、CAS 代码和 Lean 形式化的 AI 辅助评测流程，用于评估语义正确性和逻辑正确性。与传统的一次性 LLM 判断相比，该流程将自然语言证明的假阳性判定从 23% 降至 6%，并将支持代码的判断准确率从 46% 提升至 58%。这一方法为大规模评估研究级数学提供了方法论，并可能应用于数学和 AI for Science。
items.author_line: Alan Sorani, Ashvni Narayanan, Michael Shalyt, Tali Monderer, Rotem Kalisch, Hila Barkan, Elyasheev Leibtag, Shachar Weinbaum, Carsten Schneider, John Campbell, Ido Kaminer

items.title: Scaling Lean Theorem Proving for Real-World Code Verification
items.abstract_or_text: We present EasyProver, a Lean proving system built from recursive agents with isolated contexts, asynchronous search, parallel tactic probing, and an elastic elaboration service. Using an off-the-shelf frontier model with no additional training, it proves 669/672 PutnamBench problems and all six IMO 2026 formalizations and resolves 597/600 NTP4VC verification conditions and all 189 VERINA tasks by proof or refutation. Because these benchmarks are close to saturation, we also introduce Aegis, which converts competitive programming problems into much harder verification tasks over real implementations. The pipeline writes safe Rust solutions, translates them into Lean with Aeneas, generates specifications, and labels each frozen statement with a kernel-checked proof or refutation. It produces 2,045 differentially validated Rust-Lean program pairs and 11,533 candidate specifications. Unlike hand-written benchmarks, these tasks carry implementation-level obligations from fixed-width arithmetic, explicit failure, generated loops, casts, and functionalized mutation. On a stratified sample of 2,000 statements, EasyProver proves 1,054 (52.7%) within a 30-minute budget per statement. The same tasks can also be used to benchmark other provers and as rewards for reinforcement learning.
items.summary_zh: 提出 EasyProver，通过递归代理、异步搜索和并行 tactic 探索扩展 Lean 定理证明，并构建 Aegis 实现级验证任务。系统在 PutnamBench、IMO 2026 形式化、NTP4VC 和 VERINA 上接近饱和，在 2,000 个更难语句上 30 分钟内证明了 52.7%。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 证明结果由 Lean kernel 检查，任务生成和规模化评测较为可检验；基准接近饱和，作者因此补充了更难的实现级任务。
items.abstract_zh: 我们提出 EasyProver，这是一个由递归代理构成的 Lean 证明系统，具有隔离上下文、异步搜索、并行 tactic 探索和弹性 elaboration 服务。使用未经额外训练的现成前沿模型，它证明了 PutnamBench 的 669/672 道题目、全部六个 IMO 2026 形式化，并通过证明或反证解决了 NTP4VC 的 597/600 个验证条件和 VERINA 的全部 189 个任务。由于这些基准已接近饱和，我们还引入 Aegis，将竞赛编程问题转换为针对真实实现的更困难验证任务。该流程编写安全 Rust 解答，通过 Aeneas 将其翻译为 Lean，生成规格，并为每个冻结语句标注由 kernel 检查的证明或反证。它生成了 2,045 对经过差分验证的 Rust-Lean 程序以及 11,533 个候选规格。不同于手写基准，这些任务包含来自定宽算术、显式失败、生成循环、类型转换和函数化可变操作的实现级义务。在分层抽取的 2,000 个语句样本上，EasyProver 在每个语句 30 分钟的预算内证明了 1,054 个（52.7%）。这些任务也可用于评测其他证明器以及作为强化学习奖励。
items.author_line: Debargha Ganguly, Divya Raghunathan, Dejan Jovanović, Vikash Singh, Soonho Kong, Aaron Tomb, Aman Goel, Ferhat Erata, Sam Bayless

items.title: Countable Nondeterminism in Weighted Programming with an Application to Mechanized Foundations for Probabilistic Program Verification
items.abstract_or_text: Weighted programming is a framework by Batz et al. for describing mathematical models or optimization problems as imperative programs parametrized over semirings and then analyzing them with program verification techniques like weakest precondition calculi. Applications include reasoning about expected outcomes of probabilistic programs and competitive analysis of online algorithms. We extend weighted programming with (1) countable nondeterminism and (2) user-defined additive rewards, where programs are parametrized over modules instead of semirings. The resulting framework enables reasoning about expected resource consumption of probabilistic programs and about optimal scores of combinatorial games. A technical challenge is that wp-calculi for weighted programs with (1) and (2) over arbitrary modules can be unsound, because it is well-known that continuity properties commonly used in program semantics break in the presence of countable nondeterminism. We study conditions under which a wp-style transformer for reasoning about weighted programs is sound with respect to an operational ground truth defined in terms of weighted decision processes (WDPs) - transition systems that generalize Markov decision processes by drawing transition weights and state rewards from a module. Based on those conditions, we show that a range of concrete instances of the weighted programming framework enjoy sound weakest precondition reasoning. We demonstrate the usefulness of our wp-semantics through case studies for different modules. We mechanized our extended weighted programming framework and our main soundness results in the interactive theorem prover Lean. Instantiating these results for probabilistic programming yields, to the best of our knowledge, the first mechanized proof of a fixed point characterization of minimal expected rewards in Markov decision processes with countable nondeterminism.
items.summary_zh: 扩展加权程序框架以处理可数非确定性和用户定义加性奖励，研究 weakest-precondition 推理何时保持语义正确，并在 Lean 中机械化主要框架与可靠性定理。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 核心贡献是可检查的语义条件与 Lean 机械化证明，直接关联概率程序和组合博弈的形式化验证。
items.abstract_zh: 加权程序是 Batz 等人提出的框架，用于把数学模型或优化问题描述为参数化于半环的命令式程序，然后用最弱前置条件演算等程序验证技术进行分析。其应用包括推理概率程序的期望结果和在线算法的竞争分析。我们将加权程序扩展为支持：（1）可数非确定性；（2）用户定义的加性奖励，此时程序参数化于模而非半环。得到的框架能够推理概率程序的期望资源消耗以及组合博弈的最优得分。一个技术难点是：对任意模而言，带有这两种扩展的 weakest-precondition 演算可能是不健全的，因为众所周知，在存在可数非确定性时，程序语义中常用的连续性性质会失效。我们研究在何种条件下，面向加权程序的 weakest-precondition 变换器相对于一个以加权决策过程（WDP）为操作性真值的语义是健全的；WDP 是马尔可夫决策过程的推广，其转移权重和状态奖励取自某个模。在这些条件下，我们证明加权程序框架的一系列具体实例享有健全的 weakest-precondition 推理。我们通过针对不同模的案例研究展示该 weakest-precondition 语义的用途。我们在交互式定理证明器 Lean 中机械化了扩展后的加权程序框架及主要健全性结果。将这些结果实例化到概率编程后，据我们所知，这给出了第一个关于具有可数非确定性的马尔可夫决策过程中最小期望奖励的定点刻画的机械化证明。
items.author_line: Sebastian Körner, Oliver Emil Bøving, Christoph Matheja

items.title: Verifiable LLM-Guided Focal SMT Solving for Quantified Arrays
items.abstract_or_text: Large language models can often identify useful semantic structure in formal artifacts, but their outputs cannot be trusted as proofs or solver decisions. We study whether LLMs can instead guide formal reasoning systems through a narrow, solver-verifiable interface. We instantiate this idea in quantified array SMT solving, where modern instantiation-based techniques can fail when key ground terms and equalities are hidden by auxiliary variables, axiom guards, and nested array terms. We observe that many instances are largely driven by a small set of focal ground terms or constraints, similar to the backdoor sets in SAT solving. Building on this, we present LinguaArray, a framework where an LLM proposes a small Semantic Focus Set (ground terms/constraints), while a conventional SMT solver remains the sole proof engine and certifies all results. LinguaArray uses these LLM-suggested, solver-validated finite sets to significantly enhance solver capability, solving additional satisfiable and unsatisfiable instances that the backend alone fails to solve. It interacts within a finite time and then falls back to the backend solver to mitigate potential regressions. Evaluation on 1015 SMT-LIB instances across five logics under 1200s timeout (including LLM latency) shows that LinguaArray solves up to 69.1% of instances and increases solved-instance counts by 105%--397% over the corresponding backends.
items.summary_zh: 提出 LinguaArray，让 LLM 只提出可由 SMT 求解器验证的 Semantic Focus Set，由传统求解器承担最终证明。在 1,015 个 SMT-LIB 实例、五种逻辑和 1,200 秒超时下，最多解决 69.1% 实例，并较后端提升 105%–397%。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 清晰划分模型启发与求解器证明职责，所有结果由 SMT 后端认证；报告了包含 LLM 延迟的统一超时评测。
items.abstract_zh: 大语言模型通常能够识别形式化工件中的有用语义结构，但其输出不能作为证明或求解器决策而被信任。我们研究一种替代方案：让 LLM 通过狭窄且可由求解器验证的接口来引导形式化推理系统。我们以量化数组 SMT 求解为实例，其中基于实例化的现代技术可能会因关键地面项和等式被辅助变量、公理守卫以及嵌套数组项隐藏而失败。我们观察到，许多实例主要由一小组焦点地面项或约束驱动，这类似于 SAT 求解中的后门集合。基于此，我们提出 LinguaArray：LLM 提出一个小型 Semantic Focus Set（地面项/约束），而传统 SMT 求解器仍是唯一的证明引擎，并认证所有结果。LinguaArray 使用这些由求解器建议并验证的有限集合，显著增强求解器能力，解决后端单独运行无法解决的额外可满足和不可满足实例。它在有限时间内交互，随后回退到后端求解器，以减轻潜在退化。在包含五种逻辑的 1,015 个 SMT-LIB 实例上、采用 1,200 秒超时（包括 LLM 延迟）的评测显示，LinguaArray 最多解决 69.1% 的实例，并较对应后端将已解决实例数量提高 105%–397%。
items.author_line: Kunhang Lv, Rui Han, Fuqi Jia, Yuhang Dong, Feifei Ma, Jian Zhang

items.title: PCM: A Proof-Carrying Message Protocol for Verifiable Multi-Agent Communication
items.abstract_or_text: When one AI agent tells another that "the tests passed" or "a person approved this refund", the receiver has only the sender's word. A2A and MCP authenticate the channel, but the sender is the party in doubt, so a prompt-injected agent can launder fabricated facts and authority through a multi-agent system. We present Proof-Carrying Messages (PCM), a protocol in which each claim carries evidence: records from an append-only Merkle log that the agent cannot write, with inclusion proofs, signed by an attesting signer the agent cannot control. Receivers check messages offline and give each claim a three-valued result: proven, unproven or failed. A claim that rests only on the agent's own report is never proven. Authority travels as grant chains rooted in a recorded human approval, and the chains can only narrow. We specify four claim types, a typed caveat algebra, replay rules that survive restarts, and strict readings that make independent verifiers agree, and we prove the resulting security properties. On a pre-specified benchmark of 926 messages from real runs, 712 of them lies in 16 classes, PCM accepts 10 lies, all of them stale evidence (1.4%, 95% CI 0.8-2.6%). Plain A2A accepts all 712, and models of six deployed protocols (A2A with signed Agent Cards, uAgents, RFC 9421, SCITT, AP2, Verifiable Intent) accept 504-712. Two independent verifiers agree on all 926 verdicts, and verification takes about 1 ms.
items.summary_zh: 提出 Proof-Carrying Messages（PCM）协议，让每条跨代理声明携带不可由代理自行写入的 Merkle 日志证据和签名。协议给出三值判定并证明安全性质；在 926 条真实运行消息上，两名独立验证器判定完全一致，验证约 1 ms。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 把多代理通信中的“声明可信度”转化为离线可验证证据，并用预先指定基准和独立验证器报告可检验结果。
items.abstract_zh: 当一个 AI 代理告诉另一个代理“测试通过了”或“某人批准了这笔退款”时，接收方只有发送方的一面之词。A2A 和 MCP 能够认证通信信道，但可疑对象恰恰是发送方，因此遭到提示注入的代理可能在多代理系统中转移虚假的事实和权限。我们提出 Proof-Carrying Messages（PCM），一种让每条声明都携带证据的协议：证据来自代理无法写入的追加式 Merkle 日志，包含 inclusion proof，并由代理无法控制的证明签名者签名。接收方离线检查消息，并为每条声明给出三值结果：已证明、未证明或失败。仅依赖代理自述的声明永远不会被判为已证明。权限通过根植于已记录人工批准的授权链传递，而且链条只能收窄。我们规定四类声明、带类型的 caveat 代数以及可在重启后继续工作的重放规则，并采用严格解读，使独立验证器达成一致；我们还证明了由此得到的安全性质。在一个预先指定、包含真实运行中 926 条消息的基准上，其中 712 条属于 16 类谎言，PCM 接受了其中 10 条，且全部是过期证据（1.4%，95% CI 为 0.8–2.6%）。普通 A2A 接受全部 712 条；六种已部署协议的模型（带签名 Agent Cards 的 A2A、uAgents、RFC 9421、SCITT、AP2、Verifiable Intent）接受 504–712 条。两名独立验证器对全部 926 条消息的判定完全一致，验证耗时约 1 ms。
items.author_line: Bravish Ghosh

items.title: Deogen: Automatic Benchmark Generation for Reasoning over Policies
items.abstract_or_text: Language models are increasingly being deployed in regulated settings, where a model must apply given rules to the facts of a situation to determine a verdict. Benchmarking this capability, known as deontic reasoning, remains a costly and manual process, with existing datasets largely hand-crafted. In this paper, we present DeoGen, a scalable, automatic, and parametrizable benchmark generator for deontic reasoning. By autoformalizing policy rules to first-order logic, we can construct decision trees that capture possible outcome trajectories. Each path down a tree becomes a benchmark entry, with each tree producing combinatorially many entries relative to tree depth. Paths ending at a leaf entail a verdict, while non-leaf paths measure a model's ability to abstain when presented with insufficient information. Evaluations show frontier models return the correct verdict 89-92% of the time. Notably, performance degrades (22-40% correct) on entries without sufficient information to claim a verdict, even with explicit instructions to abstain in such cases. In all, DeoGen presents an automatic, scalable, and parametric method for generating deontic reasoning benchmarks.
items.summary_zh: 提出 DeoGen，通过把政策规则自动形式化为一阶逻辑并展开决策树，自动生成带充分信息和信息不足情形的义务推理基准。前沿模型在有充分信息的条目上正确率 89%–92%，信息不足时降至 22%–40%。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 任务生成机制和“应拒答/应弃权”测试明确，结果揭示模型在信息不足时的可靠性边界。
items.abstract_zh: 语言模型正越来越多地部署在受监管场景中，此时模型必须根据给定规则和情境事实作出判定。对这种被称为义务推理的能力进行基准测试仍然昂贵且依赖人工，现有数据集大多由手工构造。本文提出 DeoGen，一个可扩展、自动化且可参数化的义务推理基准生成器。通过把政策规则自动形式化为一阶逻辑，我们可以构造捕获各种结果轨迹的决策树。树上的每条路径都成为一个基准条目：每棵树生成的条目数相对于树深呈组合增长。到达叶节点的路径蕴含一个判定，而非叶路径则衡量模型在信息不足时是否能够弃权。评测显示，前沿模型在 89%–92% 的情况下返回正确判定。值得注意的是，在没有足够信息作出判定的条目上，即使明确要求模型在此情形下弃权，正确率仍降至 22%–40%。总体而言，DeoGen 提供了一种自动、可扩展且可参数化的义务推理基准生成方法。
items.author_line: Sam Kouteili, William Liang, Keeran Murray, Adriana Zhou, Ramesh Viswanathan, Scott Shapiro, Ruzica Piskac

items.title: Scaling Mathematical Proof Supervision from Structured Textbooks
items.abstract_or_text: Mathematical supervision for language models is typically flattened into isolated problem-solution pairs, discarding the curricular organization and evidential structure of the original sources. We introduce TOME-Math (Textbook-Oriented Mathematical Evidence), a large-scale corpus that converts 2,118 textbooks spanning the core areas of university-level mathematics subjects into approximately 380K structured proof-supervision records while preserving chapter order, proposition-proof links, dependency references, and source provenance. Leveraging these structural signals, we explore curriculum learning across multiple mathematical subjects and characterize scaling patterns with supervision volume and source breadth. At full scale, fine-tuning on TOME-Math raises the unweighted mean score across our held-out evaluations and established public benchmarks by 16.7 percentage points over the base model, while exceeding all three public instruction-data baselines evaluated in aggregate. Our findings highlight structured textbooks as both a scalable source of mathematical supervision and an empirical framework for studying the impact of data organization on mathematical reasoning. We will release the corpus to facilitate further research on structured mathematical supervision.
items.summary_zh: 发布 TOME-Math 语料库，将 2,118 本大学数学教材转换为约 38 万条保留章节顺序、命题—证明链接、依赖引用和来源信息的结构化证明监督记录。基于全量数据微调后，留出评测和公开基准的非加权平均分较基座提升 16.7 个百分点。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 监督数据结构和来源可追溯，评测覆盖留出集与公开基准；分数提升反映训练语料效果，不直接证明模型能独立完成形式化证明。
items.abstract_zh: 语言模型的数学监督通常被压平成孤立的问题—解答对，从而丢失原始来源的课程组织和证据结构。我们引入 TOME-Math（Textbook-Oriented Mathematical Evidence），一个大规模语料库，将覆盖大学数学核心领域的 2,118 本教材转换为约 38 万条结构化证明监督记录，同时保留章节顺序、命题—证明链接、依赖引用和来源信息。利用这些结构信号，我们探索跨多个数学学科的课程学习，并刻画监督规模和来源广度带来的缩放规律。在完整规模下，使用 TOME-Math 微调后，模型在留出评测和既有公开基准上的非加权平均分比基座模型提高 16.7 个百分点，并在总体上超过所评估的三个公开指令数据基线。我们的结果表明，结构化教材既是可扩展的数学监督来源，也是研究数据组织如何影响数学推理的经验框架。我们将发布该语料库，以促进后续研究。
items.author_line: Youqing Fang, Zhouqi Hua, Yinhao Tang, Yuzhe Gu, Lingkai Kong, Bin Liu, Weiming Zhang, Kai Chen, Yanan Sun, Wenwei Zhang

items.title: Incentivizing Self-Learning in Large Language Models via Reinforcement Learning
items.abstract_or_text: Large language models (LLMs) draw on parametric knowledge and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) to solve knowledge-intensive tasks. Yet problem solving in unfamiliar domains calls for tightly coupled knowledge acquisition and reasoning, beyond factual retrieval and aggregation or learning solely from a preassembled context. We study self-learning -- autonomously retrieving, studying, and applying knowledge from long-form reference materials on the fly. To investigate this capability, we formulate a textbook-based mathematical problem-solving task. LLMs must navigate textbook exposition, learn and apply relevant principles, and construct proofs for exercises, with reference solutions withheld. We introduce a BookNavigator interface to support this human-inspired study process and incentivize self-learning through reinforcement learning (RL) with fine-grained rewards. Experiments show that our method improves performance across in-domain and out-of-domain textbooks and subjects, raising Intern-S2-Preview-35B's overall proof accuracy from 51.5% to 79.5% and outperforming RL-trained textbook-free and fixed-retrieval baselines. These gains extend to complex long-context benchmarks involving different task types, with improvements over the base model of 1.7 and 2.3 percentage points on BrowseComp-Plus and CL-bench, respectively. Together, these findings suggest that RL can foster a domain-agnostic self-learning strategy, highlighting the potential of self-learning from long-form corpora to strengthen broader problem-solving capabilities on complex, long-context tasks.
items.summary_zh: 研究 LLM 从教材中自主检索、学习并应用知识来构造证明的能力，提出 BookNavigator 接口和细粒度奖励的强化学习方法。Intern-S2-Preview-35B 的总体证明准确率从 51.5% 提升至 79.5%，并超过无教材和固定检索基线。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 把“边读教材边证明”定义为可测任务，并比较域内、域外教材及长上下文基准；证明正确性仍取决于具体评测设置。
items.abstract_zh: 大语言模型依靠参数化知识和检索增强生成（RAG）解决知识密集型任务。然而，陌生领域的问题求解需要把知识获取与推理紧密结合，而不仅是事实检索与聚合，或只从预先组装的上下文中学习。我们研究自学习，即自主地即时检索、研读并应用长篇参考材料中的知识。为研究这一能力，我们构造了一个基于教材的数学问题求解任务。LLM 必须浏览教材阐述，学习并应用相关原理，为练习题构造证明，同时无法看到参考解答。我们引入 BookNavigator 接口，以支持这种仿人的学习过程，并通过带细粒度奖励的强化学习激励自学习。实验表明，我们的方法在域内和域外教材及学科上都能提升表现，使 Intern-S2-Preview-35B 的总体证明准确率从 51.5% 提高到 79.5%，并超过不使用教材和使用固定检索的强化学习基线。这些提升还扩展到包含不同任务类型的复杂长上下文基准：相较基座模型，在 BrowseComp-Plus 和 CL-bench 上分别提高 1.7 和 2.3 个百分点。总体而言，这些结果表明强化学习能够培养与领域无关的自学习策略，凸显从长篇语料中自学习以增强复杂长上下文问题求解能力的潜力。
items.author_line: Lingkai Kong, Yuzhe Gu, Haiteng Zhao, Zijian Wu, Youqing Fang, Zhouqi Hua, Yanan Sun, Kai Chen, Wenwei Zhang

items.title: Beyond Selected Breakthroughs: Evaluating Language Models on Randomly Sampled Mathematical Conjectures
items.abstract_or_text: The last year has seen a shift in AI-assisted mathematics, with frontier language models producing proofs of and counterexamples to long-standing open conjectures. However, studying only the current set of major breakthroughs provides an incomplete picture of LLM capabilities and the computational resources needed to achieve reported results. To address this, we introduce a new dataset, OpenConjecture, which collects conjectures from mathematics papers published on the arXiv since February 2026. We use these conjectures as a source of open mathematical problems, and apply frontier GPT models to a random sample of 200 of these conjectures over three passes using a reproducible protocol without problem-specific mathematical guidance. Rather than attempt expert verification of these candidate solutions, we analyze the types of problems for which LLMs produce solutions and the characteristics of these solutions. The models we test produce candidate solutions for roughly 60% of the conjectures, with counterexamples about 1.3 times more common than proofs. We estimate solution novelty, assess how solutions cite and relate to existing literature, and analyze whether the proposed resolution relies on either an error in or underspecification of the conjecture. We find that models sometimes propose resolutions that are outside the authors' intent (e.g., proposing the trivial group as a counterexample) and that a number of proofs follow closely from existing results, but that some resolutions exhibit at least moderate novelty. Our findings underscore the need for evaluations that go beyond correctness to assess fidelity to the intended statement, attribution, and the nature of the mathematical contribution.
items.summary_zh: 提出 OpenConjecture，从 2026 年 2 月以来的 arXiv 数学论文中收集猜想，并按可复现实验协议测试前沿 GPT 模型对随机抽取的 200 个猜想。模型约为 60% 的猜想生成候选解答，但作者未进行专家核验，且反例多于证明。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 随机抽样和多轮协议有助于避免只展示突破性案例，并明确指出正确性、意图一致性和新颖性需要分开评估。
items.abstract_zh: 过去一年，AI 辅助数学出现了转向：前沿语言模型开始为长期未解猜想生成证明和反例。然而，只研究当前少数重大突破，无法完整反映 LLM 的能力以及已报道结果所需的计算资源。为此，我们引入新数据集 OpenConjecture，收集自 2026 年 2 月以来发表在 arXiv 数学论文中的猜想。我们把这些猜想作为开放数学问题的来源，并按照一个不提供针对具体问题数学指导的可复现实验协议，对其中随机抽取的 200 个猜想进行三轮测试。我们没有尝试让专家核验这些候选解答，而是分析 LLM 产生解答的问题类型及这些解答的特征。所测试的模型为约 60% 的猜想生成了候选解答，其中反例出现的次数约为证明的 1.3 倍。我们估计解答的新颖性，评估解答如何引用和关联现有文献，并分析提出的解决方案是否依赖于猜想本身的错误或欠规范。我们发现，模型有时提出偏离作者意图的解决方案（例如以平凡群作为反例），一些证明紧跟已有结果，但也有部分解决方案表现出至少中等程度的新颖性。我们的研究强调，评测不能只看正确性，还应评估对原命题的忠实程度、归因以及数学贡献的性质。
items.author_line: Helen Jenne, Davis Brown, Jesse He, Henry Kvinge

items.title: Evaluating Causal Reasoning in LLMs: A Case Study in the Challenges of Procedural Generation
items.abstract_or_text: Large language models (LLMs) appear to represent and reason about a large range of phenomena. In particular, recent studies have examined whether LLMs can accurately reason about causation. One of the most commonly used benchmarks for evaluating formal causal reasoning in LLMs is CLadder, a framework for procedural generation of benchmark data sets that was released in 2023. Experiments with CLadder appear to indicate that LLMs can perform formal causal reasoning in a large percentage of generated examples. In this paper, we examine what can be reliably inferred when LLMs perform well on test sets produced by CLadder. We identify several examples of superficial and highly predictive patterns that the CLadder generator embeds in data sets it generates. We find that even simple models such as random forests perform well on CLadder-generated data sets after training on a sample of generated data. We also find that the performance of many commercial LLMs on CLadder test sets is extremely brittle and that removing large sections of the text that are critical for formal causal reasoning has almost no effect on performance. Given these results, the most likely hypothesis for the strong performance of state-of-the-art LLMs on CLadder is that they are exploiting superficial patterns learned from exposure to training data from the generator. Any inference that LLMs are exhibiting more complex causal reasoning must rule out this hypothesis.
items.summary_zh: 重新审视 CLadder 因果推理基准，发现其生成器包含简单且高预测性的表面模式；随机森林也能取得较好表现，商业 LLM 对关键文本删减极其脆弱。研究警告，基准高分不应直接解释为复杂因果推理。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 这是对推理评测可靠性的直接审计，给出数据生成偏差、删减实验和简单模型对照，能帮助校准数学与形式推理基准的解读。
items.abstract_zh: 大语言模型似乎能够表示并推理大量现象。特别是，近期研究考察了它们是否能准确地进行因果推理。用于评估 LLM 形式因果推理的最常见基准之一是 CLadder，这是一个于 2023 年发布的基准数据集程序生成框架。CLadder 实验似乎表明，LLM 能够在很大比例的生成样例上执行形式因果推理。在本文中，我们研究当 LLM 在 CLadder 生成的测试集上表现良好时，究竟可以可靠地推断什么。我们识别出 CLadder 生成器在数据集中嵌入的若干表面且高度预测性的模式。我们发现，像随机森林这样简单的模型，在生成数据样本上训练后，也能在 CLadder 生成的数据集上取得良好表现。我们还发现，许多商业 LLM 在 CLadder 测试集上的表现极其脆弱：删除对形式因果推理至关重要的大段文本，几乎不会影响性能。鉴于这些结果，最可能的假设是，当前最先进 LLM 在 CLadder 上的强表现来自利用从生成器数据中学到的表面模式。任何关于 LLM 展现了更复杂因果推理能力的推断，都必须排除这一假设。
items.author_line: Justin Clarke, Isha Karn, Patrick Murray, KJ Hill, David Jensen

items.title: Reasoning or Pattern Exploitation? Mechanistic Insights from RL-Trained Language Models
items.abstract_or_text: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly described as acquiring "reasoning" skills after reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards. However, whether these gains reflect genuine reasoning or more superficial adaptations remains underexplored. In this work, we probe LLMs trained in a finite and exhaustively analyzable logical domain, namely Tic-Tac-Toe, and trace how internal representations evolve across reinforcement learning (RL) with Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO). Quantitatively, RL yields high accuracy and robustness across prompt variations, suggesting the emergence of game reasoning. Mechanistic interpretability, however, paints a different picture: features extracted with sparse autoencoders (SAEs) reveal that models primarily adapt to rely more heavily on information already explicit in the prompt, such as whose turn it is, game progression and board occupancy. In comparison, high-level concepts like board symmetries and strategic forks remain weakly represented, raising concerns that reasoning benchmarks overestimate model abilities. This suggests that RL-driven "reasoning" may conflate task-specific adaptations to input information with reasoning ability. We provide, for the first time: (i) a systematic interpretability pipeline tracing representation dynamics across RL training in small-scale LLMs; (ii) an extension of SAE-based feature discovery to hypothesis-driven testing in a finite logical domain; and (iii) an interpretability-based demonstration that RL post-training neither adds nor removes concept information but reorganizes which features dominate the representation, with causal interventions locating the decision downstream of it, in the late-layer state.
items.summary_zh: 在可穷举分析的井字棋逻辑域中追踪 RL 训练后的语言模型表征变化。模型准确率和提示鲁棒性提高，但稀疏自编码器与因果干预显示其更多依赖提示中显式信息，棋盘对称性和战略分叉等高层概念表征较弱。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 把模型准确率与机制解释、因果干预结合，提供了检验“推理”是否只是模式利用的可操作方案。
items.abstract_zh: 大语言模型在获得带可验证奖励的强化学习能力后，越来越常被描述为获得了“推理”技能。然而，这些提升究竟反映真正的推理，还是更表面的适应，仍缺乏充分研究。在本工作中，我们在一个有限且可穷举分析的逻辑领域——井字棋——中进行探查，并追踪模型在使用 Group Relative Policy Optimization（GRPO）进行强化学习过程中的内部表征如何演化。从定量上看，强化学习带来了在提示变化下的高准确率和鲁棒性，似乎表明出现了游戏推理。然而，机制可解释性给出了不同图景：从稀疏自编码器（SAE）提取的特征显示，模型主要调整为更加依赖提示中已经明确的信息，例如轮到谁行动、棋局进程和棋盘占位。相比之下，棋盘对称性和战略分叉等高层概念的表征仍然较弱，这引发了对推理基准高估模型能力的担忧。这表明，强化学习驱动的“推理”可能把针对输入信息的任务特定适应与推理能力混为一谈。我们首次提供：（i）一个追踪小型 LLM 在 RL 训练中表征动态的系统性可解释性流程；（ii）将 SAE 特征发现扩展到有限逻辑领域中的假设驱动测试；（iii）一种基于可解释性的展示，说明 RL 后训练既未增加也未移除概念信息，而是重组了哪些特征在表征中占主导地位，并通过因果干预将决策定位在后层状态中的信息之后。
items.author_line: Aishik Nagar, Cheston Tan

items.title: UPPAAi: Towards LLM-Assisted Modeling, Verification, Analysis and Synthesis
items.abstract_or_text: For more than three decades, UPPAAL has supported the modelling and analysis of real-time and cyber-physical systems. Yet building a suitable model, formalising the intended properties, choosing analysis techniques and interpreting counterexamples remain iterative tasks that demand substantial expertise. Large language models (LLMs) can offer plausible explanations and even solutions, but they are not necessarily correct. We present UPPAAI, an extension of UPPAAL in which users construct, explain, debug and specify models in dialogue with an LLM. The guiding principle is that the user requests, the LLM proposes, explains and orchestrates, and UPPAAL verifies. UPPAAI exposes the UPPAAL editor, queries and verifier through a Tools API. We report on seven case studies, from explaining to a newcomer to learning a controller, covering timed automata, stochastic hybrid automata and strategy learning. LLMs proved to be extremely helpful in not just generating solutions but also pro-actively suggesting relevant UPPAAL features it was not asked about.
items.summary_zh: 将 LLM 接入 UPPAAL 的建模、解释、调试和规格编写流程，由用户提出请求、LLM 编排、UPPAAL 验证。七个案例覆盖 timed automata、stochastic hybrid automata 和策略学习，展示了工具调用式形式验证的人机协作模式。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 验证职责明确留在 UPPAAL，案例任务可复核；目前主要是七个案例研究，缺少大规模定量对照。
items.abstract_zh: 三十多年来，UPPAAL 一直支持实时系统和信息物理系统的建模与分析。然而，构建合适的模型、形式化目标性质、选择分析技术以及解释反例，仍是需要大量专业知识的迭代任务。大语言模型可以提供看似合理的解释甚至解决方案，但它们不一定正确。我们提出 UPPAAI，这是 UPPAAL 的一个扩展，用户可以与 LLM 对话来构建、解释、调试和指定模型。其指导原则是：用户提出请求，LLM 提议、解释并编排，而 UPPAAL 负责验证。UPPAAI 通过 Tools API 暴露 UPPAAL 编辑器、查询和验证器。我们报告七个案例研究，从向新手解释到学习控制器，覆盖 timed automata、stochastic hybrid automata 和策略学习。LLM 不仅在生成解决方案方面非常有帮助，还会主动建议用户未曾询问的相关 UPPAAL 功能。

items.title: Learning to Formulate: Agentic Hardware-Software Co-Design of AI Infrastructure through Progressive Optimization and Verification
items.abstract_or_text: AI infrastructure, the chips and software that train and serve AI models, is designed in layers. Layers make the system manageable, but they also fix which choices an optimizer can consider. Gains that need the chip and its software to change together are excluded before optimization begins: the formulation leaves them out. Language-model agents make it possible to revisit these boundaries, but an agent's proposal cannot show by itself that a design is correct or optimal. We present Formulaic, a flow that divides the work. The agent writes the formulation, a mathematical solver optimizes within it, and verification and measurement check its assumptions and results. The agent refines the problem step by step, from the computation graph toward the chip. Each step is a template: a family of programs with the conditions under which they are correct. Wall relaxation searches the chip by pricing the hardware limits that bind the software. This paper takes a first step, through separate studies rather than one end-to-end run. On NVIDIA GB10, templates the agent wrote run complete Qwen3-8B layers 1.075\times faster than SGLang. In a simulated Ventus GPU study, joint design cuts the worst-scenario cycles of Qwen2.5-0.5B to 0.428 of the reference, against 0.934 for software alone. On a five-step GEMM refinement chain, reusing proofs makes checking 2.51\times faster.
items.summary_zh: 提出 Formulaic，将 LLM 负责问题表述、数学求解器负责优化、验证和测量负责检查假设与结果，逐步推进 AI 基础设施的软硬件联合设计。报告了 GB10 加速、Ventus 模拟研究以及复用证明后的检查加速。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 把代理生成的数学表述与求解器、验证器和实测结果分离，验证链条清晰；论文明确说明目前是分离实验而非端到端运行。
items.abstract_zh: 训练和服务 AI 模型的芯片与软件构成的 AI 基础设施是分层设计的。分层使系统易于管理，但也固定了优化器可以考虑的选择。需要芯片和软件共同变化才能获得的收益，会在优化开始前被排除，因为问题表述没有包含它们。语言模型代理使重新审视这些边界成为可能，但代理提出的方案本身无法证明设计正确或最优。我们提出 Formulaic，一个分工明确的流程。代理编写问题表述，数学求解器在其中进行优化，验证和测量则检查其假设与结果。代理从计算图逐步推进到芯片，逐步细化问题。每一步都是一个模板：一族带有正确性条件的程序。Wall relaxation 通过对约束软件的硬件限制定价来搜索芯片。本文通过相互独立的研究而非一次端到端运行，迈出了第一步。在 NVIDIA GB10 上，代理编写的模板运行完整的 Qwen3-8B 层，比 SGLang 快 1.075 倍。在模拟的 Ventus GPU 研究中，联合设计将 Qwen2.5-0.5B 的最坏情形周期降至参考值的 0.428，而仅软件设计为 0.934。在五步 GEMM 细化链上，复用证明使检查速度提高 2.51 倍。

items.title: @Alezander9：Compaction is a mistake. When an agent's context fills up, tools like Codex and Claude Code compact it: 1. The model pre
items.abstract_or_text: Compaction is a mistake. When an agent's context fills up, tools like Codex and Claude Code compact it: 1. The model prefills the entire session again 2. It writes a summary of everything so far 3. A new session starts from that summary I measured this on a real ~400k-token session with Opus 5.5: → 38 s and 1.99 when the prompt cache has expired → 29 s and 0.17 when it hasn't And the summary is lossy. The exact error message, the file path, the one number you needed is often gone. So I do something new for Mainplane Context retrieval works the other way around. Mainplane keeps the full record of every session as a file. When the context fills up, a new session starts right away with one instruction: "You are continuing session X. Retrieve key context from it as you go." The agent searches the old session and copies the exact lines it needs, when it needs them. Same session, same model: 15 s and 0.10 to get back to work. It does not depend on a cache hit, and nothing is paraphrased. This is the bitter lesson applied to agent memory. Don't hand-design what the model should remember. Give it the full record and good tools, and let it decide. Mainplane is open source (MIT). Link in the first comment.
items.summary_zh: 作者分享 Mainplane 的上下文检索方案：保留完整会话记录，在新会话中按需检索原文，并给出约40万 token 会话的耗时与成本对比。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 编辑判断：这是可复核的代理工程经验，直接讨论上下文压缩的信息损失、缓存依赖和恢复效率；项目采用 MIT 许可证开源。
items.abstract_zh: 压缩是个错误。当代理的上下文填满时，Codex 和 Claude Code 等工具会进行压缩：1. 模型重新预填充整个会话；2. 写下迄今为止的一切摘要；3. 新会话从该摘要开始。我在一次真实的约 40 万 token 会话中测得：提示缓存过期时耗时 38 秒、成本为 1.99；缓存未过期时耗时 29 秒、成本为 0.17。而摘要是有损的。你需要的确切错误消息、文件路径或某个数字经常会消失。所以我为 Mainplane 做了个新方案：上下文检索反过来工作。Mainplane 把每个会话的完整记录保存为文件。上下文填满后，立即启动新会话，只给出一条指令：“你正在继续会话 X。需要时从中检索关键上下文。”代理会搜索旧会话，在需要时复制所需的准确行。同一会话、同一模型：恢复工作耗时 15 秒、成本为 0.10。不依赖缓存命中，也没有任何改写。这是把“苦涩的教训”应用于代理记忆。不要手工设计模型应该记住什么；给它完整记录和良好工具，让它自行决定。Mainplane 采用 MIT 许可证开源。链接在第一条评论。

items.summary_zh: microsoft/DeepSpeed 发布 v0.19.9，加入 vocab-parallel logprobs/entropy/KL 的 Triton 内核、RVV 向量化 CPU Adam，并修复 AutoEP/AutoTP、ZeRO 状态管理、通信日志和 masked softmax 数值稳定性等问题。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 这是对大模型训练与推理基础设施有实际性能、稳定性和兼容性影响的版本，适合训练平台维护者和分布式推理工程师评估升级。升级前应针对 CUDA/Triton、CPU 后端、ZeRO-3、AutoEP 以及分布式 checkpoint 做回归测试。
items.abstract_zh: 仓库 microsoft/DeepSpeed，版本 v0.19.9；变化包括新增 vocab-parallel logprobs、熵和 KL 的 Triton 内核，加入 RVV FP32 CPU Adam 内核，改进 AutoEP/AutoTP 与 ZeRO 的参数和专家并行处理，修复 masked softmax 数值稳定性、通信日志回归及多项分布式状态与检查点问题。
